Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take the full follow-up damage, so move with minions between you and Ahri. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return, so keep moving outside its return path even after dodging the first pass.
Ahri.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Most of Ahri's damage is magic, so build magic resist first, but magic resist cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return.
Ahri.fight: Dodge Ahri E Charm from behind minions, then poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire and follow with Hwei E Grim Visage to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. When Ahri R Spirit Rush is down, look for a chance to catch her with Hwei E Crushing Maw.
Ahri.laning: Prioritize CS while keeping a minion wave between you and Ahri E Charm. Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and look to poke with Signature only when Ahri is lined up behind minions. Save mana and subject cooldowns so you don't miss the next wave.
Ahri.combo: If Ahri R Spirit Rush is down and you've dodged Ahri E Charm, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The bolt deals more damage while she is immobilized, and the second hit in this sequence also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Ahri.escape: The moment after you dodge Ahri E Charm is your chance to engage.
Ahri.phase: Hwei is weak early until enough subjects are available, so farm while dodging Ahri E Charm. The available information isn't enough to determine who has the advantage later, so deal damage safely from the edge of your range.
Ahri.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along Ahri's approach, and use Hwei E Grim Visage to push back the frontliner as the engage starts. Save Hwei E Subject: Torment to deal with enemies who get on top of you instead of spending it all on poke. When enemies are grouped and can't easily scatter, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then chain Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits a minion, so avoid its outward and return paths even from behind the wave. Akshan E Heroic Swing is a wall-based dash, so keep your distance near walls and interrupt his engage with Hwei E Grim Visage. When you're low and Akshan R Comeuppance's targeting indicator appears, move behind terrain instead of running alone into the open.
Akshan.build: Akshan deals mostly physical damage, and Hwei has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps.
Akshan.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, but don't stand in the path where Akshan Q Avengerang extends through minions. If jungle pressure is heavy, place Hwei E Gaze of the Abyss at river entrances or brush entrances.
Akshan.escape: Akshan E Heroic Swing is his mobility, so close the distance only right after he uses it. Catch him with Hwei E Crushing Maw and continue dealing damage while he can't escape.
Akshan.phase: Even later, fight from the edge of your range instead of stepping forward, and watch for Akshan E Heroic Swing to reset when he gets a takedown participation.
Akshan.teamfight: Block the approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure and interrupt Akshan with Hwei E Grim Visage when he comes in. When an ally catches an enemy, follow up with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and Subject: Disaster damage. If you have the Scoundrel mark, don't face Akshan alone; fight outside his finishing range.
Akshan.combo: After Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The lightning deals more damage to immobilized targets, and if the second spell hits, Hwei P Signature of the Visionary also detonates.
Akshan.fight: Right after you make Akshan use Akshan E Heroic Swing, you have a chance to fight. Catch him with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then follow up with Hwei Q Severing Bolt. While Akshan E Heroic Swing is available, don’t step forward for an extended trade.

Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging Akali E Shuriken Flip's first shuriken. If it hits and marks you, the second dash follows Hwei as he retreats. You can't dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so be ready to interrupt her engage with Hwei EQ Grim Visage.
Akali.build: Early on, weather the lane with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Akali deals mostly magic damage and Hwei has low magic resist, so build magic resist first. Rush Zhonya's Hourglass to wait out her engage if she gets on top of you, and mix in penetration when increasing your damage to account for Akali's high magic resist.
Akali.fight: Dodge the first shuriken of Akali E Shuriken Flip, then fight after Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali R Perfect Execution are down. When Akali emerges from the smoke, interrupt her engage with Hwei EQ Grim Visage, then follow with another subject's damage spell to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. You can also hit her with skillshots during the brief moment she's revealed as she enters the smoke.
Akali.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure and prioritize CS. Once two subjects are available, hit Akali with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire when she is lined up behind minions, then follow with Hwei EQ Grim Visage.
Akali.combo: When Akali's mobility is down or you've pulled her in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. The bolt deals more damage while she's immobilized, and the second hit in this sequence also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. When Akali dashes in, interrupt her first with Hwei EQ Grim Visage, then follow with Subject: Disaster.
Akali.escape: Dodging the first shuriken of Akali E Shuriken Flip removes one way for her to get on top of you. Catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment and deal damage when both Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali R Perfect Execution are down. If only one mobility ability is down, she can still escape with the other, so don't go too deep.
Akali.phase: During this window, safely collect CS and build a health lead when Akali's smoke and dashes are down.
Akali.teamfight: Place Hwei QE Molten Fissure along Akali's approach, then push her back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage when she actually comes in. Don't spend Subject: Torment on poke beforehand; save it to stop Akali when she gets on top of you. When an ally catches an enemy or enemies are grouped, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and Subject: Disaster.

Alistar.build: Early on, weather the lane with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Alistar's main damage is magic, so build magic resist first. Against an opponent who fights at close range like Alistar, rush Zhonya's Hourglass to buy time to withstand his engage.
Alistar.fight: Keep your distance and don't engage first while Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are available. Once both are down, reposition, catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment, and follow with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster. When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't commit your damage; back off and attack again after it ends.
Alistar.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire when it's safe. Save mana and push the lane or reposition while Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down.
Alistar.combo: After Alistar W Headbutt is down, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. This sequence meets the bolt's amplification condition and also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a short trade, hit him with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then complete Signature with Hwei E Grim Visage.
Alistar.escape: Close the distance only right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down. While Alistar's engage tool, W Headbutt, is unavailable, restrain his movement with Hwei E Subject: Torment and attack. Don't stay long in a position where both abilities can threaten you again.
Alistar.phase: You remain squishy later, so fight from the edge of your range and take opportunities when Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down.
Alistar.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along Alistar's approach, and use Hwei E Grim Visage to push back the frontliner when he engages. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't commit your damage to him; if needed, interrupt his engage again with Hwei E Subject: Torment even after he activates R. When an ally catches an enemy, chain Hwei R Spiraling Despair and Hwei Q Subject: Disaster to target the damage dealers in the back.
Alistar.watch: Watch out for Alistar’s combo: he closes the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, knocks you up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then stuns you with Alistar E Trample. Hwei has no spell to escape on his own, so stay outside Alistar W Headbutt’s range and interrupt his approach with Hwei E Grim Visage. Near a turret, don’t give Alistar room to get behind you and knock you in.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can be detonated with a recast, so dodge from outside its range instead of just sidestepping a little. If you’re hit by Q or caught in an enlarged Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so get out of the storm immediately. Keep your distance in narrow paths, where Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.
Anivia.build: Get a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads. Anivia’s main damage is magic, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Anivia.fight: After dodging Anivia Q Flash Frost, hit Hwei Q Devastating Fire from a safe distance, then follow with Hwei E Grim Visage and trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Anivia has no mobility, so when you get a chance to close in with your allies, catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment. If Anivia P Rebirth is still available, don’t try to break the egg alone; pressure it with your allies.
Anivia.laning: After that, clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, then look to poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire when Anivia stands behind and overlaps with minions. Don’t use your Subject spell every time it comes off cooldown, or you may miss the next wave.
Anivia.combo: When you have a clear chance to catch Anivia, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on her position. This sequence amplifies Severing Bolt’s damage and also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light trade, follow Hwei Q Devastating Fire with Hwei E Grim Visage.
Anivia.escape: Anivia Q Flash Frost being on cooldown is your chance to close the distance. Hwei has no skill to escape on his own, so avoid engaging in narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can block your retreat. If things get dangerous, back away with Hwei W Fleeting Current and stop the chase with Hwei E Grim Visage.
Anivia.teamfight: Start fights in the wider lane rather than jungle passages, where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape. Block the approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and if enemies come in, turn back the frontliner with Hwei E Grim Visage. If your allies catch an enemy, follow up with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and Hwei Q Subject: Disaster to deal damage.

Ambessa.watch: When you see Ambessa W Repudiation’s windup, stop attacking and move out of range. If you dodge the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, the second hit won’t come out; if it’s hard to dodge, the area closer to her is less painful than the blade’s edge. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest champion in a straight line and is unstoppable, so don’t line up with your allies’ backline.
Ambessa.build: Get Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps. Ambessa’s main damage is physical, and Hwei has low armor, so build armor first. Also prioritize Zhonya’s Hourglass so you can wait out Ambessa’s engage when she gets on top of you.
Ambessa.fight: Don’t stand forward and trade while Ambessa still has her abilities and Ambessa P Drakehound’s Step charges. Right after she uses all her abilities and spends her charges, catch her with Hwei E Crushing Maw and follow with Hwei Q Severing Bolt. If you see Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and leave its area first.
Ambessa.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire after Ambessa uses her abilities. Save Hwei E Subject: Torment to interrupt her engage, accounting for Ambessa’s dash.
Ambessa.combo: When Ambessa’s abilities and charges are down, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on her position. This sequence meets Severing Bolt’s amplification condition and also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a short trade, hit with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then complete the Signature with Hwei E Grim Visage.
Ambessa.escape: The moment Ambessa’s abilities and the charges after her dashes are all spent is Hwei’s window to engage. If you’re hit by Ambessa E Lacerate, don’t wait for the slow to wear off; create distance with Hwei W Fleeting Current. Answer Ambessa’s engage with Hwei E Grim Visage, but don’t try to interrupt Ambessa R Public Execution, since it is unstoppable.
Ambessa.phase: The source does not specify an advantage in the late game.
Ambessa.teamfight: Position so Hwei and your allies’ backline aren’t at the end of Ambessa R Public Execution’s line. Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure in Ambessa’s approach path, and answer an actual engage with Hwei E Grim Visage. If your allies catch an enemy first, hit with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure to deal damage.

Annie.watch: If white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, so stay outside her ability range. Keep your distance so multiple allies aren’t hit together by the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. After Tibbers is summoned, don’t stay in place even if you kill Annie.
Annie.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Annie’s damage is magic, so Hwei should build magic resistance first to give himself a chance to withstand her burst.
Annie.fight: Annie has short range, so Hwei should poke from a distance and look for moments when she steps forward. After Annie P Pyromania’s stun is used, restrain her movement with Hwei E Subject: Torment, then follow with a spell from another Subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Annie.laning: After that, clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire once the Disaster Subject’s cooldown is back. Don’t force your way forward while Annie’s stun is ready.
Annie.combo: When Annie P Pyromania’s stun has been spent, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on her position. Severing Bolt deals more damage to an immobilized target, and the second hit in this sequence also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Annie.escape: Right after Annie spends Annie P Pyromania’s stun is your chance to close the distance. Annie has no mobility, so catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment and keep attacking. If you see the indicator that her stun is ready again, back out of range.
Annie.phase: Even after that, keep Annie’s stun and Hwei’s weak defensive stats in mind and fight from a distance.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, don’t stand clustered with your allies. When Annie steps forward, stop her engage with Hwei E Grim Visage and place Hwei Q Molten Fissure in her approach path. After your allies catch an enemy, deal damage with the Disaster Subject, and keep your distance when Tibbers is summoned.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health, and staying in it for a long time adds bonus damage and Stardust, so stand behind minions and immediately move out of its aim line. If caught by Aurelion Sol E Singularity, move out at once; don’t enter its area at low health because you risk being executed. Once he has accumulated Stardust, Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend causes an area knockup and shockwave, so keep your distance from allies.
AurelionSol.build: Get a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads. Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so Hwei should build magic resistance first.
AurelionSol.fight: Hwei has no skill to escape, so keep your distance and don’t stay in Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light for long. If Aurelion Sol comes in with W Astral Flight, interrupt his engage with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. Right after his W is used, catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment and follow with damage from the Disaster Subject.
AurelionSol.laning: After that, clear waves with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and poke with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire when Aurelion Sol stands behind and overlaps with minions. Avoid taking unnecessary ability damage so Aurelion Sol doesn’t gain Stardust.
AurelionSol.combo: If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, pull him in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on his position. This sequence meets Severing Bolt’s damage amplification condition and also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light trade, hit with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, then complete the Signature with Hwei EQ Grim Visage.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after you force Aurelion Sol to spend W Astral Flight is your chance to close the distance. If his catch spell is also down, catch him with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and follow up with damage.
AurelionSol.phase: In the late game, Aurelion Sol’s permanent Stardust scaling works against you, so limit his growth from the early game onward.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Block Aurelion Sol’s approach with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and turn him back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage if he comes in with W Astral Flight. If your allies catch an enemy, hit with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and damage from the Disaster Subject. Keep your distance from allies so you aren’t all hit by Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend.

Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley spreads across a wide area and slows, so dodge by moving sideways. Ashe Q Ranger's Focus increases her damage while active, so keep your distance. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don’t start a small skirmish from out of vision. If the arrow comes your way, change direction to dodge it.
Ashe.build: Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Hwei has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.fight: The moment after you dodge Ashe W Volley sideways is your chance to trade. If Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, keep your distance until it wears off. Then pull Ashe in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and follow with Hwei QW Severing Bolt.
Ashe.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and poke with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire when Ashe stands behind and overlaps with minions. Ashe’s basic attacks continually refresh their slow, so don’t stay within her attack range for long.
Ashe.combo: When you have an angle to catch Ashe, pull her in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled enemy meets the condition for the lightning’s damage amplification, and hitting with two different abilities also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light poke, hit with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, then follow with Hwei EQ Grim Visage to complete the Signature.
Ashe.escape: When engaging Ashe, look for the moment right after Ashe W Volley is used. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don’t start a fight from out of vision. If Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, engage after it wears off. Ashe has no ability to create distance on her own, so once you’re in range, pin her down with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Ashe.phase: In late-game team fights, block approach routes with Hwei QE Molten Fissure from maximum range and deal damage safely.
Ashe.teamfight: Keep Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow in mind and don’t start a small skirmish from out of vision. In team fights, block the enemy’s approach routes with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and when they start engaging, turn back the front line with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. When enemies group up, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them together again with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then add Hwei QE Molten Fissure.

Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, you take damage again when the curse returns, and the return damage increases the lower your health is. Once cursed, move out of the straight line between you and Aurora, and if your health is low, retreat before the curse returns. When Aurora R Between Worlds appears, you’re slowed when leaving it, so create distance before she casts it.
Aurora.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance first, since Aurora deals mostly magic damage and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance.
Aurora.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and only try to poke when Aurora stands behind and overlaps with minions. If jungle pressure is heavy, set Hwei E Gaze of the Abyss in advance at river approaches or brush entrances.
Aurora.combo: After Aurora’s mobility abilities are down, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. While she’s pulled in, she meets the condition for the lightning’s damage, and hitting with a second ability also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. If Aurora W Across the Veil is still available, first block her landing spot with Hwei Q Molten Fissure.
Aurora.escape: Don’t engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is used. She can also escape with Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora R Between Worlds, so look especially for a window before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up. If Aurora uses her leap to engage and doesn’t contribute to a kill, that’s your chance to catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Aurora.phase: In late-game team fights, block Aurora’s approach routes from maximum range and deal damage safely.
Aurora.teamfight: Cast Hwei Q Molten Fissure along Aurora’s approach route, and when she starts engaging, turn back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage. Use Hwei Q Subject: Disaster after an ally catches Aurora, and don’t spend Hwei E Subject: Torment early just to poke. If Aurora contributes to a kill, Aurora W Across the Veil’s cooldown resets, so don’t leave a low-health ally behind when retreating.
Aurora.fight: If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, place Hwei Q Molten Fissure where she is likely to reappear and wait for her to show again. Trade briefly when you have enough health, and back off if your health gets low while Aurora Q Twofold Hex is on you. After Aurora uses a mobility spell to engage, check her other mobility options as well, then catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target afterward, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or in a straight line with an ally or minion. Watch for angles where Bard E Magical Journey lets him enter from the side, and don’t unload your damage before the damage immunity from Bard R Tempered Fate ends.
Bard.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Bard P Traveler's Call and Bard Q Cosmic Binding deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Also get tenacity to prepare for being focused after a stun.
Bard.fight: Hwei keeps his distance from behind, hits with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary with Hwei E Grim Visage. When Bard E Magical Journey is down, look for a chance to catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Bard.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure and prioritize farming. Look for a Signature combo when Bard overlaps with an allied champion.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is down, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. Lightning damage increases against an immobilized target, and the second ability also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Bard.escape: The moment after you make Bard use Bard E Magical Journey is your window to close the distance. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is also down, there’s less risk of being stunned, so catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Bard.phase: Even after Bard starts leaving lane in the mid game, watch for him entering through portals and appearing in other lanes.
Bard.teamfight: Block Bard’s approach route with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and if he actually engages, turn back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage. When enemies are grouped and you can avoid the damage immunity from Bard R Tempered Fate, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure.

Azir.watch: Don’t stand in the line of Azir W Arise! soldiers. After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves them, dodge based on their new positions. Azir E Shifting Sands is an escape that grants a shield, so if he places a soldier near a wall, watch his escape direction. In narrow passages, avoid getting multiple allies pushed together by Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Azir.fight: When Azir Q Conquering Sands is down and his soldiers are still, move beside a soldier to deal brief damage, then back off. If Azir E Shifting Sands is also down, catch him with Hwei E Crushing Maw and follow with Hwei Q Severing Bolt. Avoid long trades where the soldiers keep hitting you.
Azir.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure and prioritize farming. Hwei uses a lot of mana, so don’t use his subjects whenever they’re ready.
Azir.combo: After Azir E Shifting Sands is down, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The sequence deals the lightning’s amplified damage to the pulled enemy and triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Azir.escape: The moment after you make Azir use Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to engage. If Azir Q Conquering Sands is also down and his soldiers are still, approach while avoiding the line where the soldiers are standing, then block his retreat with Hwei E Subject: Torment. Don’t enter a narrow passage together while Azir R Emperor's Divide is available.
Azir.phase: Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, so in the late game, look for opportunities from maximum range instead of taking extended fights.
Azir.teamfight: Fight across a wide area and split in different directions so you aren’t pushed together by Azir R Emperor's Divide. From maximum range, Hwei blocks approach routes with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, then turns back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage when enemies engage. If enemies are grouped and there’s no threat of an engage, follow Hwei R Spiraling Despair with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure.
Azir.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Azir’s damage is mainly magic, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.

Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls the first target it hits, so keep minions between you and him to block it. If it pulls you in, he can follow up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and R Static Field, so keep your distance near brush you don't have vision of, too.
Blitzcrank.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Blitzcrank's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, and get Zhonya's Hourglass early in case you get grabbed.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses. Keep your distance, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt. Save a finisher to account for Blitzcrank’s shield after his health has decreased.
Blitzcrank.combo: When you can catch Blitzcrank, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt where he lands. Severing Bolt deals increased damage to pulled enemies, and hitting with two different abilities also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Blitzcrank.escape: After Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, step forward to trade. If Blitzcrank E Power Fist is also down, catch him with Hwei E Crushing Maw and follow with Hwei Q Severing Bolt.
Blitzcrank.phase: The available information isn't enough to assess your relative advantage late game, so keep your distance.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: At max range, place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along Blitzcrank's approach path, and if he engages, push the front line back with Hwei E Grim Visage. After your allies catch an enemy, hit the grouped targets with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and Subject: Disaster, but don't spend Subject: Torment on poke beforehand; save it to protect yourself.
Blitzcrank.laning: Don’t stand alongside the minions. Stay behind them, prioritize farming, and clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. Get vision in the bushes, and push the lane and poke when Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or he is low on mana.

Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you are ablaze, get out of the path of Brand Q Sear or stand behind minions. Brand Q Sear stuns you if you are ablaze when it hits, and consecutive ability hits build stacks of Brand P Blaze until they explode. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from your allies to avoid its bounces.
Brand.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Brand's main damage is magic, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.fight: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, poke from max range with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire. If Brand isn't ablaze, Brand Q Sear won't stun you, giving you a chance to close the distance. Once close, use Hwei E Subject: Torment to lock Brand down, but save it if you need to stop an enemy from reaching you.
Brand.laning: Early on, prioritize farming over excessive poke, and clear waves with Hwei QE Molten Fissure. Don't last-hit beside minions Brand has set ablaze; step aside, then move in. Once two Subjects are available, when Brand is lined up behind minions, hit him with abilities from different Subjects in succession to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Brand.combo: When you have a chance to catch Brand, pull him in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt where he lands. The pull meets Severing Bolt's damage amplification condition, and the second ability hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Brand.escape: Right after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to close the distance. To avoid Brand Q Sear's stun, dodge the projectile while ablaze and engage after the fire wears off. Once close, catch Brand, who has no mobility ability, with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Brand.phase: Late game, block approach paths from max range instead of stepping forward, and damage targets your allies have caught.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces of Brand R Pyroclasm. Block approach paths with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and push the front line back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage if enemies engage. When enemies are grouped and can't easily scatter, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them together with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then follow with a Subject: Disaster ability.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals her more while you're poisoned, so retreat out of range and fight again after the poison ends. Turn your back when you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze's cast animation to avoid the stun. If you're trapped in Cassiopeia W Miasma, use the movement speed from Hwei W Fleeting Current to walk out.
Cassiopeia.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Cassiopeia's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Cassiopeia.fight: Once both Subjects are available, poke briefly. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, keep your distance until the poison wears off. Right after Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere, catch her first with Hwei E Subject: Torment and follow up with damage.
Cassiopeia.laning: Prioritize CS and clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. If Cassiopeia stands behind and overlaps with minions, hit her with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then follow with Hwei E Grim Visage to trigger Signature of the Visionary. Save mana and Subject cooldowns so you can clear the next wave.
Cassiopeia.combo: When you have a kill opportunity, pull Cassiopeia in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt where she lands. The pull meets the bolt's damage amplification condition, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Cassiopeia.escape: Right after Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere is your chance to engage. Cassiopeia has no ability to create distance, so catch her first with Hwei E Subject: Torment and use the movement speed from Hwei W Fleeting Current.
Cassiopeia.phase: In the mid-to-late game, Cassiopeia's damage over time is dangerous, so don't fight for long while poisoned.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along Cassiopeia's path, and push back the front line as it engages with Hwei E Grim Visage. Focus damage after your allies catch Cassiopeia or right after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere, using Hwei E Subject: Torment. Turn your back when you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze's cast animation to avoid the stun.

Braum.watch: Braum Q Winter's Bite hits only the first target, so stand behind minions. If it hits you, back away before stacks of Braum P Concussive Blows build up. Braum E Unbreakable blocks projectiles in the direction his shield faces, so wait for it to drop or find an angle from the side. When you see Braum R Glacial Fissure being cast, move out of its straight path and avoid the lingering slow zone too.
Braum.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to build magic resistance, and choose Mercury's Treads for tenacity. Once Braum catches you, it's easy to take follow-up hits, so prepare for crowd control. If Braum often has to engage on you, get Zhonya's Hourglass early to stall out his engage.
Braum.fight: Don't unload Hwei Q Subject: Disaster damage into the front Braum E Unbreakable faces. After Braum W Stand Behind Me is used, adjust your distance and look for a chance to catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment. Find an angle that reaches the target he's protecting instead of focusing damage on Braum himself.
Braum.laning: Dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite from behind minions, and don't stand in a straight line with Braum when there's a gap between minions. Prioritize farming and clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. Poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire and an ability from another Subject only when you have a safe chance to hit, such as when Braum is lined up behind minions.
Braum.combo: After Braum E Unbreakable drops, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt where he lands. Severing Bolt deals more damage to immobilized targets, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For poke, hit him with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then follow with Hwei E Grim Visage to complete the mark.
Braum.escape: Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used is your chance to catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment. If Braum R Glacial Fissure is also down, avoid straight-line paths as you close the distance.
Braum.phase: Once two Subjects are available, you can poke by chaining abilities from different Subjects.
Braum.teamfight: At max range, place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along the enemy's approach path, and stop Braum's engage with Hwei E Grim Visage if he comes in. Avoid the direction faced by Braum E Unbreakable and deal damage from another angle. When enemies can't easily scatter, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then finish with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages units around the first target hit, so don’t hide behind minions; back out of its range instead. Move away in particular to avoid being hit by the third missile in quick succession. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance while it hits you, so don’t stand your ground in front of him; move to the side.
Corki.build: Use Cloth Armor to withstand the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Corki’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Corki P Hextech Munitions’ true damage can’t be mitigated by resistances, and while Corki E Gatling Gun is hitting you, the effect of your bonus resistances is also reduced.
Corki.fight: Once both subjects are unlocked, hit Corki with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, then follow up with Hwei EQ Grim Visage to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Right after Corki uses W Valkyrie, he has no mobility available, so look for a chance to catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Corki.laning: Clear waves with Hwei QE Molten Fissure and prioritize farming. Poke Corki when he stands behind and overlaps with minions, but don’t waste a subject and miss the next wave. If jungle pressure is high, place Hwei EW Gaze of the Abyss at river approaches or brush entrances for vision and gank defense.
Corki.combo: If Corki W Valkyrie is on cooldown, pull him in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled enemy meets the condition for the bolt’s increased damage, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Corki.escape: The moment after you force Corki to use W Valkyrie is your chance to close the distance. Then lock down his movement with Hwei EE Crushing Maw or Hwei EQ Grim Visage and follow up with damage. Don’t force an engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available.
Corki.phase: Once both subjects are unlocked, pressure Corki during his first five levels and coordinate ganks during windows when Corki W Valkyrie is on cooldown.
Corki.teamfight: At the edge of your range, place Hwei QE Molten Fissure in Corki’s path, and if he engages, turn him back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. After your allies first catch an enemy, deal damage with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster, and save Hwei E Subject: Torment for enemies who get on you. When enemies are grouped and have trouble spreading out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow up with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and Hwei QE Molten Fissure.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge to the side instead of only moving backward. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may have its cooldown reset, so move away and create distance. Don’t fight up close while the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are still active.
Diana.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Diana’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots and build magic resistance first. Since Diana needs to get close to deal damage, build Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier as well.
Diana.fight: After dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike, keep your distance and poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire. If Diana uses E Lunar Rush to engage without a mark, interrupt her engage with Hwei E Grim Visage and retaliate. Fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear.
Diana.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and only look for a Signature combo when Diana stands behind and overlaps with minions.
Diana.combo: When poking, hit Diana with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then complete the Signature detonation with Hwei E Grim Visage. If Diana has dashed in without a mark and spent her means of escape, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. This sequence aims to meet the bolt’s increased-damage condition and trigger the Signature detonation.
Diana.escape: Your window to retaliate is right after Diana E Lunar Rush is used without a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike. Catch her with Hwei E Grim Visage or Hwei E Crushing Maw, then follow up with a Hwei Q Subject attack. If you were marked, Diana E Lunar Rush may be available again, so don’t engage; create distance instead.
Diana.phase: From this point on, Hwei should deal damage from the edge of his range instead of stepping forward.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so multiple players aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall, and secure vision on flank approaches. Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure in Diana’s path, and respond to her actual engage with Hwei E Grim Visage. Before Diana can get onto your grouped allies, help them retreat with Hwei W Fleeting Current or shield them with Hwei W Pool of Reflection.

Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Ekko Q Timewinder deals more damage on its return hit, so move out of its return path. If you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t overchase even if Ekko is low on health.
Ekko.build: Ekko’s damage is mostly magic, so Hwei should build magic resistance first. Use Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand it, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Since Ekko needs to get close to deal damage, build Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to waste his engage window.
Ekko.fight: If Ekko gets close with E Phase Dive, interrupt his engage with Hwei EQ Grim Visage and create distance. After dodging the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, start a fight when Ekko E Phase Dive and R Chronobreak are on cooldown. When dealing damage, land abilities from different subjects in sequence to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Ekko.laning: Clear waves with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and only look for a poke combo when Ekko stands behind and overlaps with minions. Move out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and when you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, move outside its area.
Ekko.combo: When you can catch Ekko, pull him in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. This sequence meets the bolt’s increased-damage condition and also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. If Ekko gets close first, interrupt his engage with Hwei EQ Grim Visage, then follow up with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire.
Ekko.escape: Don’t engage just because Ekko E Phase Dive is on cooldown. Your chance to fight comes when Ekko W Parallel Convergence and R Chronobreak are both on cooldown and he has also fully spent E Phase Dive. In particular, catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up.
Ekko.phase: The information provided isn’t enough to judge the relative strength of each champion in the late game, so deal damage safely from the backline.
Ekko.teamfight: Block Ekko’s approach with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and if he engages with Ekko E Phase Dive, turn him back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. Save Hwei E Subject: Torment to deal with enemies who get on you; don’t use it early for poke. When an ally catches an enemy, follow up on the grouped enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and the Subject: Disaster subject.

Heimerdinger.watch: When you see the landing marker, move with Hwei W Fleeting Current and get out of the center. If you’re hit, retreat beyond turret range.
Heimerdinger.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Heimerdinger’s main damage is magic, and Hwei’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don’t repeatedly trade damage in front of Heimerdinger’s turret setup; target Heimerdinger himself from the edge of your range.
Heimerdinger.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, but don’t spend time destroying Heimerdinger’s turrets one by one.
Heimerdinger.combo: When Heimerdinger is pulled in by Hwei E Crushing Maw, immediately drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The bolt deals more damage while he is immobilized, and hitting him with two different abilities also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light poke, hit him with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then complete the Signature with Hwei E Grim Visage.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no ability to create distance on his own, so go around his turret setup and catch him with Hwei E Crushing Maw.
Heimerdinger.phase: In the late game, keep avoiding the front of Heimerdinger’s turret setup and fight from the edge of your range.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: When Heimerdinger can use R UPGRADE!!!, don’t group up in a narrow area in front of an objective. Block the approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and if enemies engage, turn back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage. After an ally catches an enemy, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and add damage from the Subject: Disaster subject.

Galio.watch: When Galio W Shield of Durand is charged, it reduces damage taken and lengthens the taunt, so don’t commit your damage; walk out of its range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch during its backward windup, and if he has already engaged, interrupt him with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ). Avoid the point where both gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap, and immediately leave the area when the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance appears.
Galio.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Galio’s primary magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads to prepare for crowd control. Galio is hard to escape once he gets on you, so buy Zhonya’s Hourglass early as well.
Galio.laning: Prioritize farming over risky early poke, and clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE). Make Galio use his abilities on the wave; once he has spent mana, push the lane to limit his opportunity to influence other lanes with his ultimate. When Subject: Disaster is ready and Galio stands behind and overlapping with minions, poke him with Hwei Q Devastating Fire (QQ).
Galio.combo: After Galio’s engage tools are down, pull enemies together with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE) and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) on that spot. The pulled enemy takes increased lightning damage while immobilized, and the second ability also detonates Signature. To poke, hit Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) after Hwei Q Devastating Fire (QQ) to complete Signature.
Galio.escape: Don’t go in just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. Wait until Galio R Hero’s Entrance is also unavailable, dodge the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand, then attack. During that window, catch Galio with Hwei E Subject: Torment and follow with Subject: Disaster.
Galio.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game, so keep your distance as you fight.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero’s Entrance is ready, don’t start a skirmish with Galio’s team in another lane. In teamfights, stay at maximum range and place Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE) along Galio’s path in; respond to his actual engage with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ). Use Subject: Disaster after an ally catches an enemy, and walk out of range when the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance appears.
Galio.fight: Hwei has no mobility, so Galio’s taunt or dash can leave you vulnerable to follow-up attacks. Keep your distance when trading. While Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, hold your attacks and move outside the taunt’s range. If Hwei Q Devastating Fire (QQ) hits from a safe distance, follow up with a different subject, Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ), to trigger Signature of the Visionary.

Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster can be used both to engage and escape, so watch whether he has used it and save Hwei E Subject: Torment accordingly. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Prepare Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) along the path Fizz will take when he uses Q Urchin Strike to follow up on the shark.
Fizz.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Fizz’s primary damage is magic and Hwei has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. When Fizz can get on you and chain his abilities, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass early to spend time in stasis while he engages.
Fizz.fight: Look for a chance to counterattack right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, and use Hwei E Subject: Torment’s crowd control then. Fizz can escape if Q Urchin Strike is still available, so don’t chase deep just because one mobility ability is down. The moment Fizz misses a last hit with the empowered attack from W Seastone Trident is also a chance to trade damage.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE), then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) on that spot. The pulled target meets the conditions for the lightning damage amplification, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Fizz.escape: The window for Hwei to counterattack is before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back. Once you confirm Fizz has also used Q Urchin Strike, catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment and follow up with damage. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, first move away from your allies, then take the explosion.
Fizz.phase: In the mid and late game, cast abilities from maximum range instead of stepping forward.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand near your allies and make Fizz use E Playful / Trickster first, then focus him once it’s down. Block his engage path with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE), and send Fizz back with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) when he comes in. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.
Fizz.laning: Prioritize farming and clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE). When Fizz stands behind and overlaps with the minions, poke him with Hwei Q Devastating Fire (QQ), then follow up with a different subject’s spell to complete Signature of the Visionary. Spells cost a lot of mana, so don’t use a subject every time it comes off cooldown. Watch Fizz’s last hits and his use of E Playful / Trickster.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain dashes through low-health minions, so create distance when minions are close to dying. Dodge the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and respond to Irelia when she engages with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ). If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to hold out, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage and Hwei has low armor, so build armor first. Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass early against an opponent like Irelia who deals damage at close range.
Irelia.fight: Your chance to attack comes right after Irelia Q Bladesurge goes on cooldown and Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down. Catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment then, and follow up with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster damage. When Irelia can engage, don’t spend Hwei E Subject: Torment entirely on poke.
Irelia.combo: After Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE) and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) on that spot. The pulled enemy meets the conditions for the lightning damage amplification, and the second hit also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Irelia.escape: Treat the moment after Irelia Q Bladesurge goes on cooldown as an opportunity to engage. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, close the distance and catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment. Don’t go in recklessly while Irelia can reset Q Bladesurge.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet threaten multiple allies, so prioritize Irelia. Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE) along her engage path, and stop her engage with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) when she comes in. After an ally catches an enemy, deal damage with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster, and hit grouped enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between Hwei and Irelia, and step back when a minion is about to die. Prioritize farming and clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure. Only go for Hwei P Signature of the Visionary when Irelia is standing behind and overlapping with the minions and you can safely hit her with both spells.
Irelia.phase: After that, keep watching for Irelia’s dash and fight at the edge of your range.

Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks enemies airborne, so leave its line if you hear it charging from a bush or out of vision. A target affected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm gains a shield and increased attack damage, so don’t commit your damage during that moment. Janna R Monsoon can push nearby enemies away and disengage a fight, so account for the possibility that she will use it.
Janna.build: In the early game, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to hold out. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and build magic resistance first to prepare for Janna’s primary magic damage.
Janna.fight: Pressure Janna into using Janna E Eye Of The Storm on an ally, then focus your damage once the shield is gone. When Janna is isolated, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and land follow-up attacks. If Janna R Monsoon is still available, account for the possibility that a close-range fight could get pushed away.
Janna.laning: Prioritize farming and clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. Poke Janna’s protected ally to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, and look for an opportunity to attack after Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna W Zephyr misses. Save mana and Subject cooldowns so you can clear the next wave.
Janna.combo: After the shield from Janna E Eye Of The Storm is gone, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled target meets the conditions for the lightning damage amplification, and hitting with two different abilities also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Janna.escape: When Janna is isolated, bind her in place with Hwei E Crushing Maw and connect follow-up attacks.
Janna.phase: Even in late-game teamfights, Hwei is fragile, so attack safely from maximum range.
Janna.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along the enemy’s engage path, and send the lead engager back with Hwei E Grim Visage. When enemies are grouped and have trouble spreading out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them together again with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then follow with Subject: Disaster. Since Janna R Monsoon can push the fight away, watch for targets your allies have caught and moments when Janna is isolated.

Karma.watch: Karma R Mantra-enhanced Q Inner Flame leaves an area where flames erupt again shortly after, so leave the circle immediately if it hits you. If Karma W Focused Resolve links to you, create distance and break the tether before it roots you. Repeatedly taking Karma's abilities lets R Mantra come back sooner, so stay behind minions or outside her range.
Karma.fight: Keep your distance while Karma W Focused Resolve is available so she can't tether you first. After Karma uses W Focused Resolve, catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment, then follow with a damaging ability from another subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. If Karma R Mantra-enhanced E Inspire has shielded nearby allies, focus your damage after the shield expires.
Karma.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and poke with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire when Karma stands behind and overlaps with minions. Move behind minions or outside her range so you don't take Karma Q Inner Flame for free. Mana is tight, so don't use a subject casually.
Karma.combo: When you have a chance to catch Karma, pull her in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. The lightning deals more damage to immobilized targets, and the follow-up ability also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light trade, use Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, then Hwei EQ Grim Visage to complete the Signature proc.
Karma.escape: The window to close the distance is after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. Catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment after the movement speed boost and shield from Karma E Inspire expire. Hwei has no ability to escape on his own, so don't force an engage while tethered by W Focused Resolve.
Karma.phase: Keep to the edge of your range in the late game, and deal damage after Karma's shield expires.
Karma.teamfight: While Karma W Focused Resolve is available, an ally who engages first can get caught, so create distance and make her use it. Block the approach with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and if enemies engage, turn back the front line with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. Once the shield from Karma R Mantra-enhanced E Inspire expires and enemies are grouped, use Hwei R Spiraling Despair, Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then Hwei QE Molten Fissure.
Karma.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, and Hwei has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.

Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield absorbs Hwei's magic poke, so deal damage while Q is down. Kassadin E Force Pulse slows and has its cooldown reduced as nearby abilities are cast, so avoid unnecessary casts.
Kassadin.fight: When Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, hit him with Hwei Q Devastating Fire and trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary with an ability from another subject.
Kassadin.laning: Early on, push the wave to pin Kassadin under his turret and pressure him with your jungler to build a level and CS lead. Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, but avoid unnecessary casts near Kassadin. Save mana while farming, and poke with a Signature combo when Kassadin stands behind and overlaps with minions.
Kassadin.combo: If Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled target meets Severing Bolt's amplification condition, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Kassadin.escape: The moment Kassadin runs out of mana after using R repeatedly is also a chance to counterattack.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, Kassadin can use R to get into the back line and escape, so don't stand alone and build magic resistance.
Kassadin.teamfight: From the edge of your range, block Kassadin's approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. If he actually engages, interrupt him with Hwei E Grim Visage. Don't spend Hwei E Subject: Torment on poke; save it to deal with enemies who get on top of you. After an ally catches Kassadin, deal damage with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster.
Kassadin.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Since Kassadin needs to get close to deal damage, also prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass to run down his engage window.

Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice marks you, her next ability deals more damage, so back away until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, get outside the chain's range before it roots you. When LeBlanc uses W Distortion to engage, interrupt her with Hwei EQ Grim Visage.
Leblanc.fight: Hwei has no ability to escape on his own, so keep your distance while dealing damage. If LeBlanc W Distortion is down, look for a chance to catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment. Don't continue a trade while marked by LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice.
Leblanc.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure and prioritize CS. Save mana and subject cooldowns, keeping Hwei E Subject: Torment ready to respond to LeBlanc's engage. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from vision.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc W Distortion's return expires or has already been used, pull her in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. The lightning deals more damage to immobilized targets, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Leblanc.escape: If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, move outside the chain's range before it roots you. The moment after LeBlanc W Distortion is down is a chance to catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment. If her return has also been used or its return window has expired, continue the counterattack.
Leblanc.phase: Once both subjects are available, poke by landing abilities from different subjects in succession.
Leblanc.teamfight: Lay Hwei QE Molten Fissure along LeBlanc's approach, and turn her back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage as she starts to engage. After an ally catches an enemy, deal damage with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster. Don't spend all of Hwei E Subject: Torment on poke; keep it ready for enemies who get on top of you.
Leblanc.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. LeBlanc’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance.

Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and dashes Leona to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with your allies. Leona can activate Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so watch her distance rather than whether she has used it. When the marker for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move to the side to avoid the center stun. When Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its area before it explodes.
Leona.build: Early on, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Since Leona deals mostly magic damage and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, build magic resistance first. Against close-range opponents like Leona, prioritize Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier, too.
Leona.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage late, so fight from maximum range and block approach routes in teamfights.
Leona.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along Leona’s approach route, and when she starts engaging, turn back the frontliner with Hwei E Grim Visage. Deal damage with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster after an ally catches someone, and don’t spend Hwei E Subject: Torment entirely on poke; save it to protect yourself. If Leona P Sunlight is applied, the enemy may follow up with damage, so back off immediately.
Leona.combo: After Leona E Zenith Blade is down, pull enemies together with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. Enemies pulled in meet Severing Bolt’s amplification condition, and the second ability hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. When you need to block Leona’s approach, place Hwei Q Molten Fissure in her path and respond to an actual engage with Hwei E Grim Visage.
Leona.escape: The moment Leona E Zenith Blade goes down is your chance to close the gap or pick her off. Catch her then with Hwei E Subject: Torment and follow up with damage. While Leona still has her engage available, use Hwei W Fleeting Current to help retreat and keep your distance.
Leona.fight: Once Leona’s chain crowd control catches you, it is hard to escape, so keep your distance and poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire. After Leona E Zenith Blade is down, catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment and counterattack. While Leona W Eclipse is active, move outside its range to avoid the explosion.
Leona.laning: Early on, clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure and prioritize farming. When your opponent stands behind and overlaps with their minions, hit them with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then follow up with a spell from another subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Since your spells cost a lot of mana, don’t waste a subject on poke, and position so Leona and your ally aren’t in a straight line.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in a line with minions. If Lissandra approaches with E Glacial Path, she can follow with the root from Lissandra W Ring of Frost and the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, so keep your distance. If Lissandra can cast R Frozen Tomb on herself, wait until her damage immunity ends before dealing your finishing damage.
Lissandra.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Since Lissandra’s main damage is magic, build magic resistance first, and get tenacity to prepare for her root and stun.
Lissandra.escape: When Lissandra E Glacial Path has been used, you have a chance to close the distance. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, trade while saving the crowd control from Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Lissandra.phase: In late-game teamfights, fight from maximum range, block approach routes, and damage enemies caught by your allies.
Lissandra.teamfight: Place Hwei QE Molten Fissure along Lissandra E Glacial Path’s approach route, and when the engage starts, turn back the frontliner with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. After confirming Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, damage an enemy caught by an ally with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster. Since Lissandra can get on top of Hwei, don’t spend Hwei E Subject: Torment entirely on poke.
Lissandra.combo: After blocking Lissandra E Glacial Path or after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down, pull enemies together with Hwei EE Crushing Maw. Then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot to deal amplified damage to the immobilized target and trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Lissandra.fight: Look to trade right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. As the claw from Lissandra E Glacial Path travels, use Hwei EE Crushing Maw to prevent her from recasting it, then follow up with Hwei QW Severing Bolt.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to your minions to avoid the pierce from Lissandra Q Ice Shard, and clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure. Only poke when Lissandra stands behind and overlaps with her minions: hit her with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, then follow up with a spell from another subject.

Lulu.build: Early on, withstand Lulu’s magic damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build resistances later to match the damage type of the target Lulu is protecting.
Lulu.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and take Lulu’s basic attack poke from behind minions to reduce Pix’s bonus damage. Mana is tight, so when you poke, follow through with the second spell from another subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Lulu.phase: Even late, rather than declaring who is stronger, fight from maximum range and watch which target Lulu uses her protective spells on.
Lulu.combo: When you can catch Lulu, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on the same spot. The time she spends pulled in meets Severing Bolt’s amplification condition, and the second ability hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. If Lulu R Wild Growth is still available, don’t go deep assuming you can finish her off.
Lulu.escape: The moment Lulu W Whimsy is used on another of her allies is your chance to close the gap. If the shield from Lulu E Help, Pix! is on one of her allies, target Lulu herself with Hwei E Crushing Maw. Hwei has no spell to escape on his own, so keep your distance while Lulu still has crowd control available.
Lulu.fight: Lulu is good at absorbing one big attack, so keep your distance and poke consistently with Hwei Q Devastating Fire. If Lulu W Whimsy has been used on another of her allies and the shield from Lulu E Help, Pix! is also on one of her allies, you have a chance to catch Lulu herself with Hwei E Crushing Maw.
Lulu.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure in the enemy’s approach path, then use Hwei E Grim Visage to send the leading enemy back when they start engaging. When enemies are grouped and can’t easily spread out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow up with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure. If Lulu R Wild Growth is still available on a target, look for Lulu herself or another target instead of pouring all your attacks into them.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy makes it difficult to cast spells or attack, so don’t get close while she still has W. Lulu R Wild Growth can save its target and knock up nearby enemies, so don’t assume you can secure a kill on a target while she has R. If you’re slowed by Lulu Q Glitterlance, use Hwei W Fleeting Current to create distance.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding catches you, it’s easy to get hit by her follow-up spells, so bait out Q and dodge it before moving. Q roots the first two targets hit, so don’t stand in a line with your allies. When you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark, dodge to the side. If Lux’s spells hit you, create distance before she triggers the Illumination mark with a basic attack.
Lux.build: Early on, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle. Since Lux’s main damage is magic, build magic resistance first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Lux.laning: Clear waves with Hwei QE Molten Fissure and prioritize farming. Poke with the Signature combo only when Lux stands overlapping behind minions, and don’t use subjects out of habit to save mana. Stand offset from your allies so you can dodge Lux Q Light Binding.
Lux.escape: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then go in. Lux has no spell or mobility to create distance, so after closing in, look for a chance to catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Lux.phase: In late-game teamfights, block approach routes from maximum range instead of stepping forward, and deal damage in sync with your allies’ crowd control.
Lux.combo: When Lux Q Light Binding is down, pull enemies together with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled enemy meets QW’s amplification condition, and the second spell also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Lux.fight: Look to trade right after Lux Q Light Binding misses. If Hwei QQ Devastating Fire hits, follow up with Hwei EQ Grim Visage to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. When closing the gap, dodge Lux Q Light Binding first, then catch the immobile Lux with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Lux.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so you aren’t caught together by Lux E Lucent Singularity. Use Hwei QE Molten Fissure to block the approach, then send the leading enemy back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage when enemies engage. When enemies are grouped and can’t easily spread out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them together with Hwei EE Gaping Maw, then follow up with Hwei QE Molten Fissure or Hwei QQ Devastating Fire.

Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots, so keep your distance near brush while it is ready. Maokai cannot be targeted during the dash, so interrupt his engage with Hwei E Grim Visage after he lands. Avoid brush where Maokai E Sapling Toss has planted a sapling, and if Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from far away, move perpendicular to its path.
Maokai.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to prepare for Maokai's main damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Against opponents like Maokai who need to get close to deal damage, you can buy Zhonya's Hourglass early to stall out their engage.
Maokai.fight: Keep your distance while Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, and save Hwei E Subject: Torment to respond to his engage. Move forward to trade immediately after Maokai W Twisted Advance is used. Avoid over-poking Maokai, since repeatedly hitting him with abilities makes Maokai P Sap Magic's healing come back sooner.
Maokai.laning: Early on, prioritize farming by clearing waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. Stay out of range near brush while Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready. If a sapling follows you, lead it toward minions or monsters instead of toward your allies.
Maokai.combo: When Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, pull enemies together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt in the same spot. The pulled enemies meet the condition for increased lightning damage, and the second ability also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. If Maokai is dashing, wait until he lands before casting.
Maokai.escape: The moment after you force Maokai to use W Twisted Advance is your window to close the distance. Catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment then and follow up with damage. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp is ready, also watch your approach path so you don't get rooted.
Maokai.phase: Even later in the game, watch out for Maokai's chain roots and fight at the edge of your range.
Maokai.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure in a path where Maokai could engage, and when he actually starts engaging, push the front line back with Hwei E Grim Visage. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes, move perpendicular toward the open side to avoid being rooted. When enemies are grouped and have difficulty spreading out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and follow up with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster.

Malzahar.watch: If a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to the nearest enemy, so don't stand beside that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the two portals and delay casting until the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp cannot be cleansed with Hwei W Pool of Reflection, so don't pass through areas without vision alone while Malzahar can cast R.
Malzahar.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Malzahar's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If you need to prepare for the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp, get Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, strip it first with an ability, then look for crowd control with Hwei E Subject: Torment. If you poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, follow up with Hwei E Grim Visage or Hwei Q Molten Fissure to complete the Signature mark. Hwei has no ability to escape on his own, so keep your distance while Malzahar still has a way to catch you.
Malzahar.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, but briefly keep your distance when a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions is about to die. If Malzahar pushes the lane and Malzahar P Void Shift has been stripped, look for a chance to take him down with your jungler.
Malzahar.combo: Strip Malzahar P Void Shift first. Then pull enemies together with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt there to amplify its damage against immobilized targets and trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no mobility, so dodge the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void, strip Malzahar P Void Shift, then close the distance. Look for a window when the Voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm have disappeared or have not yet been summoned. Don't go deep alone while Malzahar can cast R Nether Grasp.
Malzahar.phase: Malzahar grows stronger as Malzahar W Void Swarm's growth stacks build, so push or pressure the lane early to give him less time to stack them.
Malzahar.teamfight: At the edge of your range, place Hwei Q Molten Fissure in the enemy's approach path, and push the front line back with Hwei E Grim Visage when they engage. After an ally catches the enemies, hit the grouped enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow up with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure.

Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots if it hits with the orb's center, so sidestep it. Mel Q Radiant Volley can follow the root, and if you are hit several times and Overwhelm stacks build up, Mel P Searing Brilliance's execute is also dangerous. When Mel W Rebuttal is active, don't throw projectiles; attack after its brief reflection window ends.
Mel.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Mel's main damage is magic and Hwei has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.fight: When you think Mel is about to use W Rebuttal, test her response with a basic attack first. After W is down, follow up with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire and an ability from another subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. If you sidestep Mel E Solar Snare, look for a chance to pull her together with Hwei EE Crushing Maw.
Mel.laning: Then clear waves with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and poke Mel when she stands behind and overlaps with minions to limit her chances to scale. Save mana and subject cooldowns so you can clear the next wave.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down and you dodge Mel E Solar Snare, pull enemies together with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt there. This sequence increases lightning damage against immobilized targets and triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary on the second hit.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility, so the window after Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down is your chance to catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment. Hwei is fragile, though, so apply crowd control and follow-up damage within range instead of moving deep forward.
Mel.phase: Mel grows stronger over time, so slow her down from the start with farming and lane pressure. Later in the game, fight from a safe distance instead of taking risky solo fights.
Mel.teamfight: When Mel W Rebuttal is active, hold your projectiles and place Hwei QE Molten Fissure in the approach path to block enemies from advancing. If enemies engage, push the front line back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage, hit the grouped enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow up with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and damage from Subject: Disaster.

Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only disengage tool and knocks back the first enemy hit, so don't recklessly close the distance while it is available. When Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases his allied marksman's range, delay frontline fights. Milio R Breath of Life heals and grants tenacity to allies, so be careful when trying to catch and finish Milio.
Milio.build: Early on, hold your ground with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Milio's damage is mostly magic, so magic resistance is the first resistance Hwei should build. If prolonged fights make the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life a problem, obtain a means of reducing healing earlier.
Milio.fight: Target Milio himself after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down. Account for the shield and movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs by pulling him together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then dropping Hwei Q Severing Bolt. Delay frontline fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active.
Milio.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure to farm and maintain lane priority. If Milio stands behind and overlaps with minions, hit him with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then look for a Signature explosion with Hwei E Grim Visage. Use mana sparingly, since wasting one subject can cost you the next wave.
Milio.combo: During the window after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, pull Milio together with Hwei E Crushing Maw. Immediately drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt there to aim for both its increased damage against immobilized targets and a Hwei P Signature of the Visionary explosion.
Milio.escape: The moment after Milio uses Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is your chance to close the distance. Milio has no mobility, so use Hwei E Crushing Maw to pull him together or Hwei E Grim Visage to interrupt an engage. If you've already used Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke, don't move forward, since you have no way to stop enemies from getting on you.
Milio.phase: Milio's team grows stronger over time, so take wave priority in lane early and drain their mana through attrition.
Milio.teamfight: At the edge of your range, Hwei should use Hwei Q Molten Fissure to block the enemy's approach path, then push the front line back with Hwei E Grim Visage when an engage starts. Delay frontline fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active, and target Milio himself, who has no mobility, when Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down. Hit grouped enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then finish with Hwei Q Molten Fissure or Hwei Q Devastating Fire.
