Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding only roots the first target it hits, so keep a minion between you and the projectile. If it hits you, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will come next. The pool is more dangerous at low health, so avoid stepping into it even while retreating. If you’re tethered by Morgana R Soul Shackles, use Hwei W Fleeting Current to get out of range before the stun lands.
Morgana.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Morgana’s magic damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. You’re likely to get hit by Morgana Q Dark Binding and then Morgana R Soul Shackles, so prioritize magic resistance and tenacity.
Morgana.fight: Keep a minion between you and Morgana Q Dark Binding while dealing damage from a safe distance. Don’t use Hwei E Subject: Torment crowd control on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield. After the shield is down and her binding has missed, look for a chance to catch a target with Hwei E Crushing Maw.
Morgana.combo: After Morgana E Black Shield is down, pull targets together with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The lightning deals more damage to an immobilized target, and the second spell also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light trade, hit Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then complete the signature with Hwei E Grim Visage.
Morgana.escape: The chance to catch Morgana with Hwei E Subject: Torment comes when Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Hwei has no ability to escape on his own, so don’t go deep toward Morgana. If you’re tethered by Morgana R Soul Shackles, use Hwei W Fleeting Current to create distance before the stun lands.
Morgana.phase: Even later in the game, deal damage safely from the edge of your range instead of stepping forward.
Morgana.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along an approach, and turn back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage as they engage. Don’t use crowd control on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield; attack with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster after the shield is down or an ally has caught them first. When the enemy team is grouped and can’t easily spread out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and pull them back together with Hwei E Crushing Maw.
Morgana.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, but stay lined up with minions that can block Morgana Q Dark Binding. Conserve mana and manage your subjects’ shared cooldowns so you can poke when your opponent stands in line with their minions.

Naafiri.watch: If you’ve been hit once by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and are bleeding, create distance to dodge the second hit. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can’t be targeted, so wait until it ends before using abilities. Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit targets a champion and dashes to them, so don’t travel alone while her R is available.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, and Hwei has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Against an opponent who closes in to deal damage, like Naafiri, get Zhonya’s Hourglass early to survive their engage and cycle Hwei’s Subject cooldowns. If the duel lasts a long time, consider anti-healing after armor.
Naafiri.fight: Fight at a distance that doesn’t give Naafiri an angle to close in with Eviscerate. If Naafiri engages, interrupt her with Hwei EQ Grim Visage, and use Hwei W Subject: Serenity’s shield or movement speed to retreat.
Naafiri.laning: Farm behind the minion line and clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure. If Naafiri stands in line behind the minions and Hwei QQ Devastating Fire hits her, follow up with a spell from another Subject to trigger the signature.
Naafiri.combo: When you need to stop Naafiri’s engage, hit her first with Hwei EQ Grim Visage to make her retreat. If you have room to counterattack, pull targets together with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt. The second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage just because Naafiri Eviscerate is on cooldown. Look for a chance before Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is available again, and catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment after Naafiri W The Call of the Pack ends. If she has just used Naafiri Eviscerate, you may also get a chance to clear the pack and counterattack.
Naafiri.phase: During mid-game roaming, Naafiri’s ambush is the biggest danger, so maintain wide vision and don’t travel alone. Later, group with your team and start a front-to-front team fight; Naafiri’s pack will be swept away by area damage, reducing her damage output.
Naafiri.teamfight: Place Hwei QE Molten Fissure along Naafiri’s approach, and turn her back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage if she actually engages. After an ally catches Naafiri, deal damage with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster, and use Hwei R Spiraling Despair when the enemy team can’t easily spread out. Right after an ally dies, Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit may become available again, so retreat immediately.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up when it hits the first target, making it easy for it to root people standing behind them, so don’t stand on top of your allies. If Neeko disappears from vision and an unexpected opponent approaches, suspect that they’re Neeko in disguise and create distance early. If you see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, leave its area; if you suspect someone is in disguise, spread out without waiting for the windup.
Neeko.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Neeko’s main source of magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads to prepare for situations where Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you and Neeko R Pop Blossom follows up.
Neeko.fight: Hwei has no ability to escape on his own, so keep your range while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is available. Once Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is on cooldown, poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then land a second hit with Hwei E Grim Visage to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Neeko.laning: Prioritize farming and clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. Only look to follow up with a spell from another Subject when Neeko stands in line behind the minions. Save mana and Subject cooldowns, keeping Hwei E Subject: Torment ready for when Neeko approaches.
Neeko.combo: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is on cooldown, pull Neeko in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. This applies the lightning’s amplification condition to the pulled Neeko, and the second spell also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Neeko.escape: The moment Neeko E Tangle-Barbs misses or goes on cooldown is your window to start a trade. If Neeko engages first, stop her with Hwei E Grim Visage and use Hwei W Fleeting Current to create distance.
Neeko.phase: Even later, getting caught once by Neeko’s root and engage is dangerous, so fight from the edge of your range.
Neeko.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along Neeko’s path in, and turn back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage as they engage. If someone you suspect is Neeko in disguise closes in, spread out from your allies to dodge Neeko R Pop Blossom. After an ally catches an enemy, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow up with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Subject: Disaster.

Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and follow-up crowd control, so keep a minion between you and the hook. Nautilus P Staggering Blow also roots you with his first basic attack, so stay out of his attack range. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don’t stand on top of an ally along its path.
Nautilus.fight: The chance to trade comes after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Then keep your distance, hit Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, and complete the signature with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. Don’t move close enough to get hit by Nautilus P Staggering Blow’s basic attack.
Nautilus.laning: Keep a minion between you and Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and prioritize farming while clearing the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure. Only poke with your remaining time when Nautilus Q Dredge Line is on cooldown. Save mana and Subject cooldowns so you can handle the next wave.
Nautilus.combo: After Nautilus Q Dredge Line is on cooldown, pull targets together with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled target meets the lightning’s amplification condition, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Nautilus.escape: Bait out Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and only close the distance right after it misses. Use Hwei E Subject: Torment crowd control then, and create distance again before Nautilus Q Dredge Line comes back up.
Nautilus.phase: Even later in the game, deal damage from the edge of your range instead of stepping forward.
Nautilus.teamfight: Place Hwei QE Molten Fissure along Nautilus’s engage path, and turn back the front line with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. Don’t stand on top of your allies so Nautilus R Depth Charge can’t knock you all up together. After an ally catches them first, attack the grouped enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and the Subject: Disaster spell.
Nautilus.build: Early on, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nautilus deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Since it’s hard to escape once he catches you, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass too.

Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns, but it falls slowly, so sidestep when you see it coming. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave as soon as you see it, too; if it hits, it can lead into more crowd control. Avoid direct fights with targets affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing and wait for its duration to end.
Nami.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nami deals mostly magic damage, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Nami W Ebb and Flow's healing is too much to handle, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Nami.fight: Target Nami right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. Pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt to aim for both its damage amplification condition and a Hwei P Signature of the Visionary explosion. Hwei has no ability to escape on his own, so keep your distance and fight during a window when crowd control is down.
Nami.laning: Afterward, clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and use the time left after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses to harass Nami. Hwei's mana costs are high, so don't use his Subjects habitually.
Nami.combo: If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses and you have an opening on Nami, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The second ability triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary, and the pulled target also meets Severing Bolt's damage amplification condition.
Nami.escape: The moment after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to close the distance. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave before approaching, and wait for the empowered duration on targets affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing to end. Nami has no ability to create distance on her own, so if you get close, lock her down with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Nami.phase: Even late in the game, Hwei is fragile, so deal damage safely from maximum range.
Nami.teamfight: When you see Nami R Tidal Wave, sidestep and watch out for the follow-up Nami Q Aqua Prison. Use Hwei Q Molten Fissure to block the enemy's approach, then push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage when they actually engage. When your allies lock down an enemy or enemies group up, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and follow up with damage from Subject: Disaster.

Pantheon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon deals mostly physical damage, and Hwei has low armor, so build armor first. Get Zhonya's Hourglass early so you can wait out Pantheon's engage and buy time for Subject's cooldown when he gets on top of you.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid trading blows directly in the early game, and trade damage from outside Pantheon W Shield Vault's range. Harass with Hwei Q Devastating Fire after Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends, then follow up with Hwei E Grim Visage to trigger Signature. Don't follow too deep while Pantheon still has his mobility ability.
Pantheon.laning: When Pantheon uses Q Comet Spear at long range to harass, keep minions between you and him, and clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. Even after both Subjects are available, conserve mana and cooldowns, and only complete Signature when you have a safe chance to harass.
Pantheon.combo: When Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends or you have an angle from the side, pull enemies together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled enemy meets Severing Bolt's damage amplification condition, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Save Hwei E Grim Visage to stop Pantheon W Shield Vault when he engages.
Pantheon.escape: The time after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again is your chance to fight aggressively. Lock Pantheon down with Hwei E Subject: Torment and follow up with damage from another Subject. If Pantheon W Shield Vault is available, don't move into its range first.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's impact falls off as the game goes on, so get through the early game safely and buy time.
Pantheon.teamfight: From maximum range, place Hwei Q Molten Fissure in Pantheon's path, and push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage when the engage starts. When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, leave the landing area. After your allies lock down an enemy, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and follow up with damage from Subject: Disaster.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so be careful not to enter its range. If Pantheon approaches, interrupt his engage with Hwei E Grim Visage. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait to attack from the front or reposition to the side. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Orianna.watch: Position yourself based on where the ball moves with Orianna Q Command: Attack. Avoid the area around the ball, where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in, and watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Orianna P Clockwork Windup empowers consecutive basic attacks, so don't trade basic attacks early.
Orianna.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Orianna deals mostly magic damage, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Orianna.fight: Look for a trade right after Orianna throws Orianna Q Command: Attack and the ball moves away from her. Orianna E Command: Protect's ongoing defensive stats won't be active then, so hit her with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then follow up with Hwei E Grim Visage to trigger Signature. Fight at ability range instead of stepping near the ball to trade basic attacks.
Orianna.laning: Once both Subjects are available, clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and harass when Orianna stands behind and overlaps with minions, or sends the ball far away. Avoid her consecutive basic attacks and save Subject cooldowns and mana for the next wave.
Orianna.combo: When you can lock Orianna down, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. Severing Bolt deals more damage to an immobilized target, and hitting with two different abilities also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Orianna.escape: Close the distance when Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down or the ball is far away and can't pull you in. Look for an opening right after Orianna Q Command: Attack is cast, too, and if you get in range, lock her down with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Orianna.phase: Hwei is also weak early until both Subjects are available, so don't force an engage just because Orianna has low base defensive stats. The available information isn't enough to determine who has the advantage late in the game.
Orianna.teamfight: Track the ball's position before Orianna herself, and avoid spots where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull in multiple players. Use Hwei Q Molten Fissure to block the approach, then push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage when enemies engage. When enemies group up and can't easily scatter, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow up with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure.

Rell.watch: Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down dashes a short distance and knocks you up, so stay out of range. If Rell and one of her allies speed up together, that's a sign Rell E Full Tilt is active; stop trading and back off. Rell Q Shattering Strike breaks shields, so sidestep it and use Hwei W Pool of Reflection afterward.
Rell.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rell deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Since Hwei has a hard time escaping once caught, get Zhonya's Hourglass early.
Rell.fight: Chip away at Rell's health with magic damage from outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. If Rell engages, push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage and create distance. After Rell's mobility ability is down, lock her down with Hwei E Subject: Torment and follow up with damage.
Rell.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and harass with Hwei Q Devastating Fire from outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. If you expect Rell to engage, don't spend Hwei E Subject: Torment on harass; save it.
Rell.combo: To stop Rell's engage, hit her with Hwei E Grim Visage, then follow up with Hwei Q Devastating Fire to trigger Signature. When Rell's mobility ability is down and you can lock her down, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot.
Rell.escape: Don't follow Rell just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down. Look for a chance to lock her down with Hwei E Subject: Torment after Rell E Full Tilt is also down, especially before that ability comes back. Create distance first right after Rell jumps down with W.
Rell.phase: Even late in the game, deal damage safely from maximum range instead of stepping forward.
Rell.teamfight: Before the engage, spread out from your allies so you aren't pulled in with them by Rell R Magnet Storm. Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure in Rell's path, then push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage when the engage starts. When your allies lock down an enemy, hit the grouped enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and follow up with damage from Subject: Disaster.

Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks enemies up at the landing point after the dash, so sidestep as soon as he starts moving. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, interrupt his engage with Hwei E Grim Visage before he reaches you, or keep terrain between you. Don’t stand in a line with your allies.
Rakan.build: Rakan’s damage is mostly magic, and Hwei has low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Prepare for crowd control rather than stacking more resistance, and rush Zhonya’s Hourglass if you keep getting caught by Rakan’s engage.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield is removed. Sidestep Rakan W Grand Entrance’s landing, then catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment and follow with a spell from another subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Rakan.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and look for a poke combo only when Rakan stands behind and overlaps with minions. Save Hwei E Subject: Torment for when you need to respond to Rakan’s engage.
Rakan.combo: Send back enemies entering with Rakan W Grand Entrance using Hwei E Grim Visage, then hit them with Hwei Q Devastating Fire to complete Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. When you have a chance to catch Rakan, pull enemies together with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot.
Rakan.escape: The moment after you dodge or bait out Rakan W Grand Entrance is your window to close the distance and fight. Catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment, but check whether Rakan is alone, since Rakan E Battle Dance can target allied champions.
Rakan.phase: The matchup’s late-game advantage can’t be determined from the information available, so keep fighting at the edge of your range.
Rakan.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along Rakan’s approach, and send back the frontliner with Hwei E Grim Visage when the engage actually begins. Don’t stand in a line with your allies, so Rakan R The Quickness doesn’t catch several of you at once. When an ally catches an enemy, follow up on the clustered enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair and Subject: Disaster spells.

Qiyana.watch: When Qiyana approaches with river element, move out of range because Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root you. If she disappears with brush element, move into allied vision. If Qiyana with rock element closes in while you’re below half health, create distance first. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes when it hits terrain, so keep your back off walls and avoid meeting her by the river or in narrow passages.
Qiyana.build: Weather the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Qiyana’s main damage is physical and Hwei has low armor, so build armor first and rush Zhonya’s Hourglass to survive her melee engage.
Qiyana.fight: Qiyana can easily attack repeatedly once she reaches Hwei, so keep your distance first. Counterattack after Qiyana uses Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and remains in front of you. In particular, catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up.
Qiyana.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and look for a poke that continues with another subject only when Qiyana stands behind and overlaps with minions. Don’t waste Hwei E Subject: Torment on poke; save it for Qiyana’s engage.
Qiyana.combo: When Qiyana E Audacity is down, pull enemies together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. This meets the condition for increased bolt damage against immobilized targets, and hitting twice with different spells also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Qiyana.escape: Right after Qiyana uses both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity is your window to step forward and counterattack. If only one is down, wait, since she can escape with the other mobility spell. Hit her with Hwei E Subject: Torment before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so build armor during this period and don’t give her an opportunity to catch you alone. Qiyana is relatively weaker late, so move with your allies, but stay away from terrain to avoid angles for Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Qiyana.teamfight: Fight at the edge of your range. Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along Qiyana’s approach and send back the frontliner with Hwei E Grim Visage when the engage actually begins. After an ally catches Qiyana, follow up with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster, and don’t spend Hwei E Subject: Torment in advance; save it to stop an enemy who reaches you. Even when grouped with allies, position away from walls and terrain so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent doesn’t hit you all at once.

Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer catches you, he can follow with the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow, so keep your distance. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move to the side of its dash path. If you see a shark shadow beneath your feet, Pyke W Ghostwater Dive is close, so retreat toward an ally or turret. Watch out for Pyke R Death From Below when your health is low.
Pyke.build: Weather the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor before magic resistance against Pyke’s damage, while also keeping enough health to stay above his execution threshold. Rush Zhonya’s Hourglass so you can let his engage window pass when he reaches you.
Pyke.fight: Hwei has no escape spell, so don’t start a trade within Pyke’s catch range. Dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side and let his engage pass, then hit him with the crowd control from Hwei E Subject and follow with damage from Hwei Q Subject. If Pyke has used only one mobility tool, he can escape with the other, so don’t chase too far.
Pyke.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and poke Pyke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire when he stands behind and overlaps with minions. If Pyke retreats after a trade, ward his escape route to reduce the chance that he disappears from vision to recover.
Pyke.combo: After Pyke’s engage misses, pull enemies together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. Bolt damage is increased against immobilized targets, and hitting a second time with another spell also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For light poke, follow Hwei Q Devastating Fire with Hwei E Grim Visage.
Pyke.escape: Your opportunity to go in is after you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow and before Pyke R Death From Below comes back up. At that moment, hit him with the crowd control from Hwei E Subject and follow with damage from Hwei Q Subject. If Pyke approaches first, stop his engage with Hwei E Grim Visage and retreat toward your allies with Hwei W Fleeting Current.
Pyke.phase: Hwei is especially weak early, so farm from a safe distance to avoid getting caught by Pyke. Pyke can still execute fragile allies late, so move with your team behind the frontline.
Pyke.teamfight: Block Pyke’s approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and send back the frontliner with Hwei E Grim Visage when Pyke goes in. Hit clustered enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then pull them together with Hwei E Crushing Maw and finish with Hwei Q Subject. Stand apart from low-health allies so you don’t enter Pyke R Death From Below’s range together.

Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first enemy hit, and after she throws them, it can stun an ally too, so stand behind minions or the frontline. When Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies so it doesn’t hit you all at once. If you catch an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, retreat so you don’t leave an ally exposed to that enemy.
Renata.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Renata Glasc’s damage is mostly magic, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Renata.fight: Renata Glasc has no built-in mobility, so when the distance closes, you may get a chance to catch her with Hwei E Crushing Maw. However, Hwei is fragile, so poke from the edge of your range with Hwei Q Devastating Fire instead of stepping forward first, then follow with a spell from another subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Renata.laning: After that, clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure and poke when Renata Glasc stands behind and overlaps with minions. Stand behind minions to dodge Renata Glasc Q Handshake, and sidestep Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Renata.escape: After Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, you have a chance to close the distance while avoiding the root. Renata Glasc has no built-in mobility, so catch her with Hwei E Crushing Maw then, but don’t go in grouped with allies if Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available.
Renata.phase: The matchup’s late-game advantage is difficult to determine from the information available, so fight at the edge of your range and watch out for Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover.
Renata.teamfight: While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, approach with space between you and your allies. Block the enemy’s approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and send back the frontliner with Hwei E Grim Visage when they go in. When enemies are clustered and have little room to scatter, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure.
Renata.combo: When you have an angle to catch Renata Glasc, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The lightning damage increases against an immobilized target, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a short trade, follow Hwei Q Devastating Fire with Hwei E Grim Visage.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, stay away from allies until the mark disappears to avoid the amplified damage and spread from Ryze Q Overload. Ryze W Rune Prison roots targets marked by E, so dodge E first.
Ryze.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early. Ryze’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Ryze.fight: Once both subjects are available, dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, then hit him with Hwei Q Devastating Fire (QQ) and a skill from another subject to trigger Signature of the Visionary. If Ryze R Realm Warp is down, look for a chance to catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Ryze.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE) and prioritize farming. Poke when Ryze stands behind and in line with minions, but conserve mana so you don’t waste one of Hwei’s subjects and miss the next wave. If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, stay away from allies until the mark disappears.
Ryze.combo: When you can catch Ryze, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE), then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) on that spot. QW deals more damage to immobilized targets, and hitting with two different skills also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Ryze.escape: If you dodged Ryze E Spell Flux, his follow-up W Rune Prison only slows you instead of rooting you, so try to trade then.
Ryze.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage late game. Manage your positioning so you don't stay within a distance where Ryze can keep refreshing his mark.
Ryze.teamfight: Block Ryze’s approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE). When he starts engaging, push the front line back with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ). If an ally catches Ryze, follow up with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster so he has no room to combo. Land Hwei R Spiraling Despair when enemies will have trouble scattering, then pull them back together with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE) while the slows overlap.

Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you are slowed, don’t stay in front of her; move out of its line. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits a champion, so spread out to either side of your allies in team fights.
Seraphine.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to stay safe, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Seraphine’s main damage is magic, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Seraphine.fight: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to close the gap and trade. Look for a moment when Seraphine is alone and away from her allies. Once you get close, catch her with Hwei E Crushing Maw and follow up with Hwei Q Severing Bolt.
Seraphine.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and when Seraphine stands behind and in line with minions, follow up with a skill from another subject to trigger Signature of the Visionary. Skills cost a lot of mana, so don’t use them every time they come off cooldown.
Seraphine.combo: If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, pull targets together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled target meets the condition for amplified bolt damage, and if the second skill hits, Hwei P Signature of the Visionary also detonates.
Seraphine.escape: Engage right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop. Seraphine has no mobility skill, so close the gap and catch her with the crowd control from Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Seraphine.phase: Even later, getting caught once by Seraphine’s crowd control makes follow-up hits more likely, so keep your distance while fighting.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies to avoid Seraphine R Encore chaining through multiple champions. Block the approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and push the front line back with Hwei E Grim Visage when enemies engage. After an ally catches an enemy, deal damage with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster. Land Hwei R Spiraling Despair when enemies are grouped and will have trouble scattering.

Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns all enemies in a line, so don’t line up with allies when Sona moves forward. If Sona steps into basic attack range as though Sona P Power Chord is ready, watch out for the empowered attack’s damage or slow and create distance.
Sona.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to stay safe, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Sona’s main damage is magic, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to use her aura, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE) and deal damage. Sona can speed up with E Song of Celerity, so don’t rely on slows alone; lock down her movement with a root or pull.
Sona.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE), and use Hwei Q Devastating Fire (QQ) to poke in your spare time. Sona is weak early and healing costs her mana, so keep trading from a safe distance, but prioritize Hwei’s mana and farming.
Sona.combo: When Sona steps forward, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE) and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) on that spot. The bolt deals more damage to immobilized targets, and if the second skill hits, Hwei P Signature of the Visionary also detonates.
Sona.escape: After Sona R Crescendo is down, there’s less pressure to avoid its stun, so look for a moment when Sona steps forward. Before Sona E Song of Celerity lets her create distance, root her with Hwei E Gaze of the Abyss (EW) or pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE).
Sona.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies so multiple champions don’t get hit by Sona R Crescendo, and block the approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE). If Sona uses her aura near allies, disrupt her position with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) or Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE), then hit clustered enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through targets in a line, so avoid the line between Senna and the minion in front of you. Block Senna W Last Embrace with minions, and if it hits you, move away from allies before the root detonates. After Senna hits you once, back off to deny her Mist collection and don’t let her land a second hit.
Senna.build: Senna’s main damage is physical, and Hwei has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor early to stay safe. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor.
Senna.fight: Once both subjects are available, poke when Senna steps forward to collect a soul. If Senna W Last Embrace is down and she isn't approaching with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, catch her with Hwei E Crushing Maw once you have safely closed the gap. Don’t spend all of Hwei E Subject: Torment on poking and leave yourself without a way to protect yourself.
Senna.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and watch where Senna will step to collect a soul so you can poke her. Avoid the path of Senna Q Piercing Darkness and block Senna W Last Embrace with minions.
Senna.combo: When you have a chance to catch Senna, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The bolt deals more damage to immobilized targets, and hitting with two different skills also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For light poke, follow up Hwei Q Devastating Fire with Hwei E Grim Visage as soon as the Q hits.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace is down, you have a chance to engage with less worry about being rooted. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, don’t engage there; back off and look for another opening from a position with vision. Once you close the gap, catch Senna with Hwei E Crushing Maw.
Senna.phase: Late game, Senna’s range and attack damage grow with her Mist, so deal damage safely from the back line.
Senna.teamfight: If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off to secure vision or cast Hwei Q Molten Fissure in the mist to block an approach. Push back the advancing front line with Hwei E Grim Visage, then damage enemies your allies have caught with Subject: Disaster. Land Hwei R Spiraling Despair when enemies are grouped and will have trouble scattering, then follow up with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure, in that order.

Soraka.watch: Soraka Q Starcall slows you, heals Soraka, and grants her movement speed, so dodge it when poking or closing the gap. Soraka E Equinox silences you and can then root you, so cast your abilities before stepping into its zone. Also account for Soraka R Wish healing the damage you deal.
Soraka.fight: Once Soraka E Equinox is down, close the gap and pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw. Dodge Soraka Q Starcall to prevent her healing and movement speed boost, so you can keep up the pressure. Instead of spreading your damage over time, burst her right after crowd control lands.
Soraka.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire when you get the chance. If you pressure the enemy marksman while dodging Soraka Q Starcall, Soraka loses health when she uses Soraka W Astral Infusion.
Soraka.combo: When Soraka E Equinox is down, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The bolt's damage is amplified against pulled enemies, and the second hit in the combo also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light trade, hit Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then follow with Hwei E Grim Visage to complete the Signature.
Soraka.escape: The moment you confirm Soraka E Equinox was used to poke is your chance to engage. Soraka has no mobility, so once you close the gap, catch her with Hwei E Crushing Maw.
Soraka.phase: In the late game, account for Soraka's healing by dealing your damage in a short burst and keeping a safe distance in teamfights.
Soraka.teamfight: Focus Soraka herself instead of repeatedly hitting enemies she heals. Block the approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and if enemies dive in, push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage. When enemies are grouped and have trouble spreading out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then add damage with Subject: Disaster.
Soraka.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Soraka deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If her healing makes fights drag on, consider anti-heal next.

Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and then returns, so even if you dodge the first wave, stay out of its path until it fully disappears. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, it drains nearby enemies and heals him, so move beyond its range.
Swain.fight: Keep your distance so you are not hit by multiple bolts of Swain Q Death's Hand, and trade after dodging the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove. Once his E is down, you have a chance to force a fight on Swain, who has no escape, with Hwei E Crushing Maw. While Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, do not fight beside him for long; move beyond its range and fight again after his ultimate ends.
Swain.laning: Last-hit near maximum range and clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure. When Swain stands behind and in line with minions, hit him with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire and complete the Signature with an ability from another Subject. Hwei uses a lot of mana, so do not spam poke; protect your farm while keeping Swain from scaling from the early game.
Swain.combo: After Swain E Nevermove is down, pull enemies together with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. Pulled enemies meet Severing Bolt's damage amplification condition, and the second hit in the combo also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light trade, hit Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, then follow with Hwei EQ Grim Visage.
Swain.escape: The window to engage opens right after Swain E Nevermove fully returns and misses. Swain has no mobility or escape, so catch him with Hwei E Crushing Maw then, and deal damage alongside an ally's gank or forced engage.
Swain.phase: Swain becomes harder to deal with over time because of his permanent stacking and healing, so use your early advantage to keep him from scaling.
Swain.teamfight: Place Hwei QE Molten Fissure along Swain's approach, and push back the front line with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move beyond its range so he cannot keep healing, then fight again after his ultimate ends. When enemies are grouped and have trouble escaping, deal area damage in this order: Hwei R Spiraling Despair, Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then Hwei QE Molten Fissure.
Swain.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Swain deals mostly magic damage, and Hwei has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the duel goes long or you’re preparing for late-game fights, get anti-heal to counter Swain’s healing.

Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, watch out for the chains that follow the first dash. If the chains hit, they knock you up and let him follow with more attacks, so dodge the second part. Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes late at the intersection, so move away immediately even if the first hit only grazes you.
Sylas.fight: Dodge the chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, then fight before that mobility ability comes back. When Sylas engages, interrupt him with Hwei E Grim Visage, then follow up with Hwei Q Severing Bolt where he is caught. Do not delay finishing him off and allow him to heal with Sylas W Kingslayer.
Sylas.laning: Once both Subjects are unlocked, clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure and poke only when Sylas, whose range is short, comes up to farm.
Sylas.combo: When Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, pull enemies together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The bolt's damage is amplified against pulled enemies, and the second ability also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light trade, hit Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then follow with Hwei E Grim Visage to complete the Signature.
Sylas.escape: Your chance to engage comes after dodging the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a way for him to move, so do not go in deep just because one ability is down. In particular, if you hit Sylas with Hwei E Crushing Maw before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back, he will have trouble escaping.
Sylas.phase: The available information is not enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game, so fight at the edge of your range.
Sylas.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure where Sylas can enter, and interrupt his engage with Hwei E Grim Visage when he dives in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Hwei E Subject: Torment is a way to deal with enemies who get on top of you, so do not use it first to poke. When enemies are grouped and have trouble spreading out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow with Hwei E Crushing Maw and Hwei Q Molten Fissure.
Sylas.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sylas deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If there’s a high risk of being caught by Sylas in melee range, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass.

Talon.watch: With Talon W Rake, getting hit by both the outgoing and returning blades stacks Talon P Blade's End and puts you in danger. If the first hit lands, get out of the return path. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, he can escape or counterattack with stealth, so do not chase recklessly.
Talon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Talon's physical damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first, but also get health to account for Talon's lethality. Since Talon needs to get close to deal damage, build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well.
Talon.fight: If Talon engages with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, interrupt him with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ). Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment and counterattack. If Talon R Shadow Assault has already been used, that is a good window to retaliate.
Talon.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE), but conserve mana and Subject cooldowns. If Talon roams, communicate his position and secure vision along the jungle paths.
Talon.combo: When Talon is pulled in by Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE), drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) on that spot. The bolt's damage increases against immobilized enemies, and the second hit also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For each ability, select the Subject first, then press its cast key again.
Talon.escape: Your window to close the gap and counterattack opens right after you make Talon use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Hit Talon with Hwei E Subject: Torment then to catch him. If you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault is also down, you have an even clearer chance to chase.
Talon.phase: Talon's influence falls off in the late game, so farm safely and play for the late game.
Talon.teamfight: Group with your allies in the back line, and place Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE) where Talon can enter. If he commits, push him back with the Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) you saved, then deal damage alongside your allies' crowd control. If Talon R Shadow Assault is still available, do not chase him alone.

Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere lands between Syndra and you, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can knock the sphere into you and stun you, so move out of its line. Syndra W Force of Will slows and deals true damage, while Syndra R Unleashed Power executes at low health, so avoid staying in an area covered with spheres while health is depleted.
Syndra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Syndra’s main damage, but also consider your total health because Syndra W Force of Will deals true damage and Syndra R Unleashed Power executes.
Syndra.fight: The moment Syndra E Scatter the Weak goes on cooldown is Hwei’s chance to deal damage. Catch her with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then follow with Hwei Q Severing Bolt to benefit from its increased damage against immobilized targets and trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Syndra.laning: Prioritize farming by clearing waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. Avoid the line of Syndra Q Dark Sphere, and use your movement speed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak on foot. Look for a poke combo only when Syndra stands behind and overlaps with minions, and save mana for the next wave.
Syndra.combo: When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is on cooldown, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a light trade, hit Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then follow with Hwei E Grim Visage to complete the Signature.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-peel, so close the distance after you confirm she has used it. Use the movement speed from Hwei W Fleeting Current to approach, then catch her with Hwei E Crushing Maw once you’re in range.
Syndra.phase: In the late game, Syndra’s abilities reach max rank and their effects may change, so watch for the altered visuals and adjust your spacing.
Syndra.teamfight: Move away from areas covered with Syndra Q Dark Sphere, where Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous. Block approaches with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage if enemies enter. When enemies are grouped and cannot easily scatter, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, gather them with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then follow with Hwei Q Molten Fissure.

Taric.watch: Dodge Taric E Dazzle by moving sideways when you see its tell. While Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active, hold your attacks and restrict movement with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Taric.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Taric’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Get Zhonya’s Hourglass early in case Taric engages on you.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, keep your distance and poke with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire. If you space so Taric cannot reach a target for a basic attack, you can also stop him from reducing his ability cooldowns with Taric P Bravado. Once Taric E Dazzle is on cooldown and you have an opening to catch him, restrict his movement with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Taric.laning: Prioritize farming by clearing waves with Hwei QE Molten Fissure. Bait Taric into using E Dazzle, dodge it sideways, then poke from range during the opening. Manage your distance so Taric cannot stand by the minion wave and basic attack, and don’t waste a subject when mana is tight.
Taric.combo: After Taric E Dazzle is on cooldown, hit Hwei QQ Devastating Fire and follow with Hwei EQ Grim Visage to trigger the Signature. If you catch Taric, gather him with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt. If Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active, stop attacking and use your damage abilities as it ends.
Taric.escape: Dodging Taric E Dazzle sideways and seeing its stun go on cooldown is your chance to fight. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so restrict his movement with Hwei E Subject: Torment when you have an opening to catch him.
Taric.phase: In the late game, keep to the edge of your range and stop Taric’s engage with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Taric.teamfight: Place Hwei QE Molten Fissure along Taric’s approach route, and push back the front line with Hwei EQ Grim Visage when the engage starts. If Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity activates, use Hwei E Subject: Torment to keep enemies in place and focus your damage after the immunity ends. If Hwei R Spiraling Despair hits grouped enemies, gather them again with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and attack with Subject: Disaster.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card locks in a gold card, stay outside his basic attack range.
TwistedFate.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because most of Twisted Fate’s damage is magic and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance when Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is ready. Once he uses the card or R Destiny is on cooldown, catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment, then follow with abilities from another subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
TwistedFate.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure.
TwistedFate.combo: After Twisted Fate uses his gold card, gather him with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled-in enemy meets Severing Bolt’s damage amplification condition, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is your chance to fight.
TwistedFate.phase: In the late game, avoid assuming you have the advantage or disadvantage; fight from the edge of your range while blocking their approach routes.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Block approaches with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and push back enemies who actually engage with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny activate within range, interrupt his movement with Hwei E Subject: Torment’s crowd control. If enemies are grouped, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and Hwei QE Molten Fissure.

Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence leads into follow-up attacks if it hits, so dodge sideways when you see him raise his hook. Change direction once more when moving up for a last hit, and avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay cannot pull you toward them.
Thresh.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Thresh’s main ability damage is magic, so build magic resistance, but tenacity is also important because Hwei is easy to hit with follow-up attacks once caught.
Thresh.fight: The moment after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to trade. When Thresh steps forward to collect a soul, hit him with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire and follow with Hwei EQ Grim Visage to trigger the Signature, but don’t step close enough to get caught.
Thresh.laning: Early on, it’s difficult to chain into the Signature before Hwei unlocks two subjects, and mana is tight, so focus on farming and managing your distance. Afterward, clear waves with Hwei QE Molten Fissure and poke when Thresh steps up to collect a soul or stands behind and overlaps with minions.
Thresh.combo: When Thresh’s catch ability is on cooldown, gather him with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. The pulled-in enemy meets Severing Bolt’s amplification condition, and the second hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Thresh.phase: Early on, before Hwei has his Signature combo, be especially careful of Thresh’s catch.
Thresh.teamfight: Place Hwei QE Molten Fissure along the approach route, and push back the front line with Hwei EQ Grim Visage when enemies from Thresh’s side engage. When enemies are grouped and cannot easily scatter, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and Subject: Disaster. If you’re trapped in Thresh R The Box, immediately decide with your allies which direction to break through.
Thresh.escape: Even after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, don’t rush in if Thresh W Dark Passage is still available. Approach once Thresh W Dark Passage is down, lock him in place with Hwei E Subject: Torment, and avoid positions where Thresh E Flay can pull you toward your allies.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns enemies when they cross its edge. If trapped inside, don’t run into the edge; move around inside and dodge Veigar W Dark Matter to the side when you see where it will land. If your health drops below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.
Veigar.build: Veigar deals mostly magic damage, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Veigar.fight: Veigar has low armor and no mobility early, so pressure him first from a safe distance. Keep moving during trades to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter. If Hwei Q Devastating Fire (QQ) hits, follow with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) to trigger Signature of the Visionary.
Veigar.laning: Prioritize farming by clearing waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE), and harass when Veigar stands behind and in line with minions. Veigar Q Baleful Strike pierces only the first two units it hits, so stand behind minions to avoid it. Avoid reckless harass that lets Veigar stack Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power by hitting you with abilities.
Veigar.combo: If Veigar E Event Horizon is down and you can close the gap, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE), then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) where he lands. The pull satisfies the bolt’s amplification condition, and if the second ability hits, Hwei P Signature of the Visionary also detonates.
Veigar.escape: The moment Veigar E Event Horizon goes on cooldown is your chance to engage. Veigar has no mobility, so after closing the gap, he’ll have trouble escaping if you hit him with the crowd control from Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Veigar.phase: Once you unlock your second Subjects, harass him and pressure him early, before Veigar has stacked much.
Veigar.teamfight: Before an objective fight, check Veigar’s position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon. From max range, Hwei can block the approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE), then turn back the lead enemy with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) if they engage. If an ally catches an enemy first, hit the clustered enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair to slow them, then deal damage with Subject: Disaster.

Vex.phase: The matchup later on can’t be determined from the available information, so block the approach from max range and deal damage safely.
Vex.teamfight: Block Vex’s approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, then turn back the lead enemy with Hwei E Grim Visage when they engage. If an ally is marked by Vex R Shadow Surge, have them move toward your team. Move low-health allies out of Vex’s range first to prevent her from getting the first takedown. After an ally catches an enemy, hit the clustered enemies with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, then follow with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster.
Vex.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vex deals mostly magic damage, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Vex.combo: For poke, hit with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary with Hwei E Grim Visage. If Vex’s shield is down and you can catch her, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt on that spot. The three abilities in the same subject share a cooldown, so choose the branch that fits the situation first.
Vex.escape: Once Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear and Vex W Personal Space’s shield are both down, your chance to fight is clearer.
Vex.fight: Look for an opening when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s Doom has been spent on the wave or for poke, and Vex W Personal Space’s shield is down. If Vex R Shadow Surge is also down, catch her with Hwei E Subject: Torment and deal damage with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster. While Vex’s fear is ready, fight from the edge of your range instead of stepping forward.
Vex.laning: Afterward, clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, then poke when Vex stands lined up behind the minions.
Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s Doom indicator is active, her basic abilities apply fear, so keep your distance. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so if you’re already within range, dodge a short distance sideways instead of running far backward. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you, she follows up with a dash, so move toward your allies immediately.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the wave; step aside to dodge it. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave immediately instead of continuing to trade inside it, and avoid the stun. Watch out for the area damage from Viktor R Arcane Storm as well.
Viktor.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Viktor deals mostly magic damage, and Hwei has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Viktor.fight: Once you unlock your second Subjects, position yourself to dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray, then follow Hwei Q Devastating Fire (QQ) with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) to trigger the mark. When Viktor W Gravity Field is down, look for a chance to close the gap and catch him with Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Viktor.laning: Prioritize farming by clearing waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE). Only look to harass and trigger Signature of the Visionary by following up with an ability from a different Subject when Viktor stands behind and in line with minions. Don’t stand in line with minions and give Viktor E Hextech Ray an angle through the wave.
Viktor.combo: After dodging the area of Viktor W Gravity Field, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE), then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) where he lands. The bolt’s amplification condition applies to the pulled target, and the second ability also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Viktor.escape: Look to engage when Viktor W Gravity Field is down. Viktor has no dash to create distance, so close the gap and lock him down with Hwei E Subject: Torment. If W Gravity Field is placed under your feet, use the movement speed from Hwei W Fleeting Current (WQ) to get out of its area.
Viktor.phase: Viktor’s growth is permanent, making the matchup harder as time goes on, so it’s better to keep him pressured early.
Viktor.teamfight: From max range, Hwei can block the approach with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE), then turn back the lead enemy with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) if they engage. Don’t stay inside Viktor W Gravity Field. After an ally catches an enemy, add damage with Hwei Q Subject: Disaster. When enemies are clustered and have trouble scattering, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, gather them with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE), then finish with Subject: Disaster.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and becomes empowered, so create distance as he approaches. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If Vladimir R Hemoplague hits you, step back and fight once the effect ends.
Vladimir.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vladimir’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. If the duel runs long, consider Grievous Wounds to counter his healing; Liandry's Torment is effective against high health.
Vladimir.fight: Save Hwei E Subject: Torment’s key crowd control while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available. Bait out the pool first with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, then catch him with Hwei EE Crushing Maw once it ends and follow up with damage.
Vladimir.laning: Once both Subjects are available, clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. When Vladimir stands behind and overlaps with minions, poke him with Hwei Q Devastating Fire and Hwei E Grim Visage.
Vladimir.combo: After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt there. The bolt deals more damage to immobilized targets, and if the second spell hits, Hwei P Signature of the Visionary also detonates.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to catch him. Vladimir’s movement speed is reduced while charging E Tides of Blood, so prepare Hwei E Subject: Torment if you can safely close the distance.
Vladimir.phase: As the game goes on, Vladimir’s health and ability power both increase, so Hwei should fight safely at maximum range.
Vladimir.teamfight: Spread out so several players aren’t hit together by Vladimir R Hemoplague, and if you’re infected, step back until it ends. Block his path in with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and push him back with Hwei E Grim Visage if he enters.

Yone.watch: Once Yone Q Mortal Steel has enough Gust stacks, it becomes an engage that knocks you up. If Yone repeatedly uses Q on minions, keep your distance until the stacks expire. Save Hwei E Subject: Torment in case Yone dives in with E Soul Unbound.
Yone.build: Build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier against opponents like Yone who deal damage at close range. Stasis can run down his engage window and give Hwei’s Subject cooldowns time to come back. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on just one resistance if you build defenses.
Yone.fight: Keep your distance when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s Gust is ready. After Yone enters with E Soul Unbound, interrupt the engage with Hwei EQ Grim Visage or root him with Hwei EW Gaze of the Abyss. Once he’s caught, follow up with a damage spell from another Subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Yone.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure and prioritize farming; poke with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire when you have an opening. If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to ready Gust, back out of range.
Yone.combo: If you can catch Yone, pull him in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt there. Severing Bolt deals more damage to immobilized targets, and the second spell also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a simple poke, hit Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, then complete the Signature with Hwei EQ Grim Visage.
Yone.escape: The window before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back is a good time to take the initiative. After Yone dives in with E Soul Unbound, Hwei E Subject: Torment’s immobilize can stop him from returning. If Yone Q Mortal Steel still has Gust stacks, keep your distance until they expire.
Yone.phase: Later, deal damage from behind while watching for Yone’s engage tools.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit several allies, and check that you aren’t alone at the very back along Yone R Fate Sealed’s path. Block the way in with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and push Yone back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage if he enters. After an ally catches him, add Hwei R Spiraling Despair and damage with Subject: Disaster.

Zed.watch: Watch where Zed W Living Shadow is and move outside Zed E Shadow Slash’s slow zone. Zed uses R Death Mark to dive in and stack damage until the mark detonates, so interrupt the engage with Hwei EQ Grim Visage.
Zed.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps, getting the armor to withstand Zed’s main damage early. Since Zed needs to get close to deal damage, build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to run down his engage window.
Zed.fight: Look for an opening right after Zed W Living Shadow is down, but don’t go in deep while Zed R Death Mark is still available. Poke with Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, then hit with a spell from another Subject to trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Zed.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and only try a poke combo when Zed stands behind and overlaps with minions.
Zed.combo: If Zed’s mobility spell is down, pull him in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw and drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt there. This sequence meets the bolt’s amplification condition and also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Zed.escape: Your opening comes after Zed uses W Living Shadow and the shadow disappears or he has already swapped positions with it. If Zed R Death Mark is still on cooldown, apply Hwei E Subject: Torment’s crowd control to block his escape.
Zed.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game, so don’t give him an early lead. Later, group with your allies to reduce the chances of being caught alone.
Zed.teamfight: Block Zed’s entry path with Hwei QE Molten Fissure, and push him back with Hwei EQ Grim Visage if he actually dives in. Don’t spend Hwei E Subject: Torment on poke beforehand; save it to stop Zed when he gets on you.

Xerath.watch: Be most wary of Xerath E Shocking Orb’s stun, as it can set up follow-up damage. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so change direction and dodge to the side when you see him charging. Start dodging as soon as Xerath R Rite of the Arcane begins.
Xerath.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath’s main damage is magic, and Hwei’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw and drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt there. Severing Bolt deals amplified damage to pulled targets, and the second hit in the combo also detonates Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Close the distance while dodging to the side as he charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse. Xerath can’t move while channeling R Rite of the Arcane, so you can dodge it or engage on him there.
Xerath.phase: Even in the late game, Hwei should block paths from maximum range and damage enemies caught by allies.
Xerath.teamfight: Block the enemy’s engage path with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and push back the frontliner with Hwei E Grim Visage if they enter. When enemies are grouped and can’t easily spread out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, gather them again with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then add damage with Subject: Disaster. Start dodging as soon as you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane’s cast animation.
Xerath.fight: Trade by closing the distance right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Use Hwei W Fleeting Current’s movement speed, and catch Xerath with Hwei E Crushing Maw once you get close. Hwei is fragile, so before then, deal damage safely from the edge of your range.
Xerath.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure and prioritize farming. Avoid the heavy damage from Xerath Q Arcanopulse, then push the lane and call your jungler when Xerath has spent a lot of mana. Hwei also uses a lot of mana, so recover some with Hwei W Stirring Lights, but don’t waste subjects out of habit.

Zilean.watch: Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns when two bombs stick to the same target. Don’t use abilities on enemies affected by Zilean R Chronoshift while they’re reviving.
Zilean.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zilean deals magic damage, so build magic resistance and prepare for being hindered by both Zilean Q Time Bomb’s stun and Zilean E Time Warp’s slow.
Zilean.fight: Once both Subjects are unlocked, hit with Hwei Q Devastating Fire, then follow with Hwei E Grim Visage to trigger Signature of the Visionary. If you dodge Zilean Q Time Bomb’s combo and close the gap, catch him with Hwei E Crushing Maw and follow with Hwei Q Severing Bolt. If Zilean E Time Warp forces you to retreat, use Hwei W Fleeting Current to increase your movement speed along your escape route.
Zilean.laning: Farm and clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and poke only when Zilean stands overlapping behind a minion.
Zilean.combo: When you can catch Zilean, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt there. The pulled target meets the condition for the bolt’s increased damage, and the second ability also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. For a short trade, use Hwei Q Devastating Fire followed by Hwei E Grim Visage.
Zilean.escape: After dodging Zilean Q Time Bomb’s second bomb is your chance to close the gap. Zilean has no mobility ability, so if you get close, catch him with Hwei E Crushing Maw. If the first bomb sticks to you, move away from allies first and get outside its blast radius.
Zilean.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure along the entry route, and push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage when they enter. When enemies are grouped, hit with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then follow with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. If it’s hard to take down a carry affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, switch your target to the more vulnerable Zilean himself.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you’ll fall asleep shortly afterward. Before that happens, move behind a wall or an ally to get out of the angle of Zoe Q Paddle Star! Even a missed bubble remains as a trap, so watch narrow paths with no vision and brush entrances. When you see Zoe winding up Zoe Q Paddle Star!, interrupt her re-aiming with Hwei E Grim Visage.
Zoe.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand her, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zoe deals mostly magic damage, and Hwei has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. However, resistance does not reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so dodging the bubble comes first.
Zoe.fight: When Zoe throws Zoe Q Paddle Star!, interrupt her re-aim with Hwei E Grim Visage. If it hits, follow with Hwei Q Devastating Fire to complete Signature of the Visionary. Zoe returns to her starting point after using Zoe R Portal Jump, so target that spot to counterattack. Hwei is fragile, so fight at the edge of your range.
Zoe.laning: Clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure. When Zoe stands overlapping behind a minion, trigger Signature of the Visionary with Hwei Q Devastating Fire and an ability from another Subject. Save mana and Subject cooldowns so you don’t miss the next wave.
Zoe.escape: The moment right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is used is your chance to engage.
Zoe.phase: The available information is insufficient to determine which champion is favored in the late game.
Zoe.teamfight: Before starting an objective, reveal the area with a Control Ward so you don’t step on a trap from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Block entry routes with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage when enemies enter. Use Hwei Q Subject: Disaster after an ally catches an enemy, and treat Zoe R Portal Jump’s starting point as an opportunity to counterattack.
Zoe.combo: When targeting Zoe R Portal Jump’s starting point, pull her in with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt. The pulled enemy meets Bolt’s amplification condition, and the second ability hit also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Zyra.watch: If you’re rooted by Zyra E Grasping Roots, you’re likely to take plant damage and then get hit by the knock-up from Zyra R Stranglethorns. Move sideways at the edge of your range to dodge the roots, and leave the area when you see the vines’ summon indicator. Don’t fight where there are many plants; back off briefly and wait for them to disappear.
Zyra.build: In the early game, withstand Zyra’s magic damage with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance first.
Zyra.fight: After dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots to the side, poke with Hwei Q Devastating Fire while the root is on cooldown. If it hits, follow with Hwei E Grim Visage for a second hit and trigger Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Don’t close the gap where Zyra has placed plants.
Zyra.laning: After that, clear waves with Hwei Q Molten Fissure and poke in the opening after dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots. Step on seeds as you pass, but when Zyra uses an ability, back away and step on them again afterward.
Zyra.combo: Once Zyra E Grasping Roots is on cooldown and you can close the gap, pull targets together with Hwei E Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt there. The bolt deals increased damage to the pulled target, and Hwei P Signature of the Visionary also detonates.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no mobility ability, so the moment after dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to close the gap. Don’t engage while the roots are still available. When escaping a dangerous position, use the movement speed increase from Hwei W Fleeting Current.
Zyra.phase: Even late in the game, don’t fight where plants have accumulated; fight at the edge of your range.
Zyra.teamfight: Avoid areas where Zyra has stayed for a long time and accumulated seeds. Move to another objective and fight on fresh ground. Block entry routes with Hwei Q Molten Fissure, and push back the front line with Hwei E Grim Visage when enemies enter. Leave the area when you see the indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, and deal damage with Hwei’s Subject: Disaster after an ally catches an enemy.

Yasuo.build: Use Cloth Armor to get through the early game, then buy Plated Steelcaps. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Get Zhonya’s Hourglass early as well to prepare for the danger when he gets on top of you.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first with light poke, then start trading. When Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, change your angle for projectile abilities or save your key abilities until the wall disappears. When Yasuo tries to get on top of you, use Hwei EQ Grim Visage to stop his engage and keep your distance.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin on your side of the lane to reduce the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can dash through. Clear the wave with Hwei QE Molten Fissure and prioritize farming, then poke when Yasuo stands behind and overlaps with minions. Save mana and your subject cooldowns for the next wave and to stop his engage.
Yasuo.combo: Break Yasuo’s shield first. When you can catch him, pull him in with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then drop Hwei QW Severing Bolt on that spot. QW deals increased damage to targets pulled in, and hitting with different abilities also triggers Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. If Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks your path, don’t rush your key abilities.
Yasuo.escape: Yasuo’s Q stacks reset right after he throws his tornado, giving you a chance to trade. While Yasuo R Last Breath is on cooldown, look for an opportunity with Hwei E Subject: Torment’s crowd control. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t go deep just because he used one dash.
Yasuo.phase: Even in the late game, deal damage safely from max range instead of stepping forward to fight.
Yasuo.teamfight: Set up Hwei QE Molten Fissure along Yasuo’s approach path, and respond to an actual engage with Hwei EQ Grim Visage. Hwei E Subject: Torment is your way to deal with enemies who get on top of you, so don’t spend it all on poke. When enemies are grouped and can’t easily spread out, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them together with Hwei EE Crushing Maw, then finish with Subject: Disaster.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade closes the distance by dashing through minions, so don’t step forward where there are lots of minions. After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice, watch for the next Q’s knock-up, and dodge sideways instead of retreating straight back as he approaches. If you’re knocked up, he can follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.

Velkoz.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance against the magic damage from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, W Void Rift, and E Tectonic Disruption, but focus on avoiding consecutive hits because resistance cannot block the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Velkoz.combo: When Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, pull him in with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE), then drop Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) on that spot. The pulled enemy meets Bolt’s amplification condition, and Hwei P Signature of the Visionary also explodes after hits from different abilities. For light poke, hit with Hwei Q Devastating Fire (QQ), then follow with Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ).
Velkoz.escape: Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, so the moment after you dodge Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is your window to engage. Close the distance then and catch him with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE); if Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is still available, don’t force your approach first.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, you have a chance to close the distance. Use Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE) to pull Vel'Koz in, then follow with Hwei Q Severing Bolt (QW) to aim for its amplified damage and the Hwei P Signature of the Visionary explosion. If Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is still available, he can knock you back when you get close, so have a way to finish your target ready.
Velkoz.laning: Clear the wave with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE), and look to harass with Hwei P Signature of the Visionary by linking a different subject only when Vel'Koz stands behind and overlaps with minions. Don’t let Vel'Koz land repeated poke, and if jungle pressure is heavy, place Hwei E Gaze of the Abyss (EW) at the river entrance or a bush entrance.
Velkoz.phase: In the late game, block the approach from the edge of your range and attack when Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down or an ally has caught Vel'Koz.
Velkoz.teamfight: Place Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE) along the enemy’s approach, and use Hwei E Grim Visage (EQ) on the front line as they engage. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting it with crowd control from a Hwei E subject. If the enemies are grouped and you can use the Torment subject, hit them with Hwei R Spiraling Despair, pull them together with Hwei E Crushing Maw (EE), then follow with Hwei Q Molten Fissure (QE) or Devastating Fire (QQ).
Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission can hit you with its split beams, so don’t dodge only sideways; move toward Vel'Koz or behind where the beams pass. If Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption knocks you up and you’re hit by follow-up abilities, Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers its true damage, so back off and let the stacks expire if they’re on you. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting it with Hwei E Grim Visage.
